text: yasmādveda evāgnihotrādīnāṃ śreyaḥsādhanānāmanityaphalatāṃ darśayati- 'tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyata evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate'
tathā brahmavijñānādapi paraṃ puruṣārthaṃ darśayati- 'brahmavidāpnoti param' ityādiḥ
ityupakramya- 'yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante / yena jātāni jīvanti / yatprayantyabhisaṃviśanti / tadvijijñāsasva / tadbrahmeti' /
tasya ca nirṇayavākyam- 'ānandāddhyeva khalvimāni bhūtāni jāyante / ānandena jātāni jīvanti / ānandaṃ prayantyabhisaṃviśanti' /

kimu vaktavyamanekaśākhābhedabhinnasya devatiryaṅmanuṣyavarṇāśramadipravibhāgahetor ṛgvedādyākhyasya sarvajñānākarasyāprayatnenaiva līlānyayena puruṣaniḥśvāsavadyasmānmahato bhūtādyoneḥ saṃbhavaḥ, 'asya mahato bhūtasya niḥśvasitametadyadṛgvedaḥ'
natu nivartate, śrutabrahmaṇo 'pi yathāpūrvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃsāridharmadarśanāt, 'śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ'

tathāca yāgādyanuṣṭhāyināmeva vidyāsamādhiviśeṣāduttareṇa pathā gamanaṃ, kevalairiṣṭāpūrtadattasādhanairdhūmādikrameṇa dakṣiṇena pathā gamanaṃ, tatrāpi sukhatāratamyaṃ tatsādhanatāratamyaṃ ca śāstrāt 'yāvatsaṃpātamuṣitvā'

ityasmādgamyate / tathā manuṣyādiṣu nārakasthāvarānteṣu sukhalavaścodanālakṣaṇadharmasādhya eveti gamyate tāratamyena vartamānaḥ / tathordhvagateṣvadhogateṣu ca dehavatsu duḥkhatāratamyardānāttaddhetoradharmasya pratiṣedhacodanākṣaṇasya tadanuṣṭhāyināṃ ca tāratamye gamyate / evamavidyādidoṣavatāṃ dharmādharmatāratamyanimittaṃ śarīropādānapūrvakaṃ sukhaduḥkhatāratamyanimittaṃ saṃsārarūpaṃ śrutismṛtinyāyaprasiddham / tathāca smṛtiḥ- 'na ha vai saśarīrasya sataḥ priyāpriyayorapahatirasti' iti yathāvarṇitaṃ saṃsārarūpamanuvadati / aśarīraṃ vāva santaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ'
'aśarīraṃ śarīreśvanavastheṣvavasthitam / mahāntaṃ vibhumātmānaṃ matvā dhīro na śocati'
'tvaṃ hi naḥ pitā yo 'smākamavidyāyāḥ paraṃ pāraṃ tārayasi'
'śrutaṃ hyeva me bhagavaddṛśebhyastarati śokamātmaviditi so 'haṃ bhagavaḥ śocāmi tvaṃ mā bhagavacchokasya pāraṃ tārayatu'
yathā 'anantaṃ vai mano 'nantā viśvedevā anantameva sa tena lokaṃ jayati'
iti vidikriyākarmatvapratiṣedhāt, 'yenedaṃ sarvaṃ vijānāti taṃ kena vijānīyāt'
tathāca 'eko devaḥsarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā / karmādhyakṣaḥ sarvabhūtādhivāsaḥ sākṣī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśca'
'yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūttatkena kaṃ paśyet kena kaṃ vijānīyāt vījñātāramare kena vijānīyāt'
tathāca śrutiḥ- 'ātmānaṃ cedvijānīyādayamastīti pūruṣaḥ / kimicchankasya kāmāya śarīramanusaṃjvaret' /
yo 'sāvupaniṣatsvevādhigataḥ puruṣo 'saṃsārī brahma utpādyādicaturvidhadravyavilakṣaṇaḥ svaprakaraṇastho 'nanyośeṣaḥ, nāsau nāsti nādhigamyata iti vā śakyaṃ vaditum, 'sa eṣa neti netyātmā'
tasmāt 'puruṣānna paraṃ kiñcitsā kāṣṭā sā parā gatiḥ'
taduktaṃ śrutyā- 'ārīraṃ vāva santaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ'
yattu jñānaṃ manyase sa sattvadharmaḥ , 'sattvātsaṃjāyate jñānam'
tathānyatra- 'ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīt / nānyatkiñcana miṣat / sa īkṣata lokānnu sṛjā iti / sa imāṃlokānasṛjata'
Dvacicca ṣoḍaṣakalaṃ puruṣaṃ prastutyāha- 'sa īkṣāñcakre / sa prāṇamasṛjata'

mantrau cemāvīśvarasya śarīrādyanapekṣatāmanāvaraṇajñānatāṃ ca darśayataḥ- 'na tasya kāryaṃ karaṇaṃ ca vidyate na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate / parāsya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca'
'apāṇipādo javano grahītā paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇaḥ / sa vetti vedyaṃ na ca tasyāsti vettā tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam'
nanu nāsti tāvaj jñānapratibandhakāraṇavānīśvarādanyaḥ saṃsārī, 'nānyo 'stī draṣṭā nānyo 'to 'stī vijñātā'
kasmātpunaḥ kāraṇādvihāya mukhyamīkṣitṛtvamaupacārikaṃ kalpyate, 'tatteja aikṣata', 'tā āpa aikṣanta'

iti ca tejo 'bannānāṃ sṛṣṭimuktvā tadeva prakṛtaṃ sadīkṣitṛ, tāni ca tejo 'bannāni, devatāśabdena parāmṛśyāha- 'seyaṃ devataikṣata hantāhamimāstisro devatā anena jīvenātmanānupravaśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi'
tathā 'sa ya eṣo 'ṇimaitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasi śvetaketo'

na pradhānamacetanamātmaśabdālambanaṃ bhavitumarhati, 'sa ātmā' iti prakṛtaṃ sadaṇimānamādāya 'tattvamasi śvetaketo' iti cetanasya śvetaketormokṣayitavyasya tanniṣṭhamupadiśya 'ācāryavānpuruṣo veda' 'tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye 'tha saṃpatsye'
tadeva sacchabdavācyaṃ kāraṇaṃ prakṛtya śrūyate- 'yatraitatpuruṣaḥ svapiti nāma satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati svamapīto bhavati tasmādenaṃ svapitītyācakṣate svaṃ hyapīto bhavati'
yathā hṛdayaśabdanirvacanaṃ śrutvā darśitam- 'sa vā eṣa ātmā hṛdi tasyaitadeva niruktaṃ hṛdyayamiti tasmādhṛdayamiti'
yathāvāśanāyodanyāśabdapravṛttimūlaṃ darśayati śrutiḥ- 'āpa eva tadaśitaṃ nayante' 'teja eva tatpītaṃ nayante'
śrutyantaraṃ ca - 'prājñenātmanā saṃpariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntaram' /
svaśabdenaiva ca sarvajña īśvaro jagataḥ kāraṇamiti śrūyate śvetāśvatarāṇāṃ mantropaniṣadi sarvajñamīśvaraṃ prakṛtya 'sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipo na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhipaḥ'
'yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati taditara itaraṃ paśyati yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūttatkena kaṃ paśyet'
'yatra nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti sa bhūmātha yatrānyatpaśyatyanyacchṛṇotyanyadvijānāti tadalpaṃ vo vai bhūmā tadamṛtamatha yadalpaṃ tanmartyam'
'niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śāntaṃ niravadyaṃ nirañjanam / amṛtasya paraṃ setuṃ dagdhendhanamivānalam'
'taṃ yathā yathopāsate tadeva bhavati' iti śruteḥ, 'yathākraturasmiṃloke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati'

yadyapyeka ātmā sarvabhūteṣu sthāvarajaṅgameṣu gūḍhastathāpi cittopādhiviśeṣatāratamyādātmanaḥ kūṭasthanityasyaikarūpasyāpyuttarottaramāviṣkṛtasya tāratamyamaiśvaryaśaktiviśeṣaiḥ śrūyate- 'tasya ya ātmānamāvistarāṃ veda'
tatra saṃśayaḥ- kimihānandamayaśabdena parameva brahmocyate yatprakṛtam 'satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma'

parasminneva hyātmanyānandaśabdo bahukṛtvo 'bhyasyate / ānandamayaṃ prastutya 'raso vai saḥ' iti tasyaiva rasatvamuktvocyate- 'rasaṃhyevāyaṃ labdhvā'nandī bhavati' iti, 'ko hyevānyātkaḥ prāṇyāt / yadeṣa ākāśa ānando na syāt / eṣa hyevānandayāti' /
'saiṣānandasya mīmāṃsā bhavati', ' etamānandamayamātmānamupasaṃkrāmati', 'ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān na bibheti kutaścana'

ityasminmantre yatprakṛtaṃ brahma satyajñānānantaviśeṣaṇairnirdharitaṃ, yasmādākāśādikrameṇa sthāvarajaṅgamāni bhūtānyajāyanta, yacca bhūtāni sṛṣṭvā tānyanupraviśya guhāyāmavasthitaṃ, sarvāntaraṃ, yasya vijñānāya 'anyo 'ntara ātmānyo 'ntara ātmā' iti prakrāntaṃ tanmāntravarṇikameva brahmeha gīyate 'anyo 'ntara ātmānandamayaḥ'
sa tapo 'tapyata / sa tapastaptvā / idaṃsarvamasṛjata / yadidaṃ kiñca'
yasmādānandamayādhikāre- 'raso vai saḥ / rasaṃhyevāyaṃ labdhvānandī bhavati'
pratiṣidhyata eva tu paramārthataḥ sarvajñātparameśvarādanyo draṣṭā śrotā vā 'nānyo 'to 'sti draṣṭā'
atha so 'bhayaṃ gato bhavati / yadā hyevaiṣa etasminnudaramantaraṃ kurute / atha tasya bhayaṃ bhavati'
anyo 'ntara ātmā prāṇamayaḥ' tasmāt 'anyo 'ntara ātmā manomayaḥ' tasmāt 'anyo 'ntara ātmā vijñānamayaḥ'

atrocyate- yadyapyannamayādibhya ivānandamayādanyo 'ntara ātmeti na śrūyate tathāpi nānandamayasya brahmatvaṃ, yata ānandamayaṃ prakṛtya śrūyate- 'tasya priyameva śiraḥ / modo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ / pramoda uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ / ānanda ātmā / brahma pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā'
apica brahma pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā ityuktatvedamucyate- 'tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati / asanneva sa bhavati / asadbrahmeti veda cet / asti brahmeti cedveda / santamenaṃ tato viduriti'
pucchavatpucchaṃ , pratiṣṭhā parāyaṇamekanīḍaṃ laukikasyānandajātasya brahmānanda ityetadanena vivakṣyate, nāvayavatvaṃ, 'etasyaivānandasyānyāni bhūtāni mātrāmupajīvanti'

iti śrutyantarāt / apica ānandamayasya brahmatve priyādyavayavatvena saviśeṣaṃ brahmābhyupagantavyam / nirviśeṣaṃ tu brahma vākyaśeṣe śrūyate, vāṅmanasayoragocaratvābhidhānāt- ' yato vāco nivartante / aprāpya manasā saha / ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān / na bibheti kutaścaneti'
tathāca sati, 'yatra nānyatpaśti nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti sa bhūmā'
brahma tu na pratiśarīraṃ bhidyate, 'satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma'
ityānantaśruteḥ, 'eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā'
iti / 'ākāśavatsarvagataśca nityaḥ' iti ca śrutī bhavataḥ / aiśvaryamaryādāśruteśca / ' sa eṣa ye cāmuṣmātparāñco lokāsteṣāṃ ceṣṭe devakāmānāṃ ca'
naca parameśvarasya maryādāvadaiśvaryaṃ yuktam, 'eṣa sarveśvara eṣa bhūtādhipatireṣa bhūtapāla eṣa seturvidhāraṇa eṣāṃ lokānāmasaṃbhedāya'

ityādau / tathā cākṣuṣe puruṣe 'saivarktatsamāsa tadukthaṃ tadyajustadbrahma' ityṛksamāsādyātmakatāṃ nirdhārayati / sā ca parameśvarasyopapadyate, sarvakāraṇatvātsarvātmakatvopapatteḥ / pṛthivyagnyādyātmake cādhidaivataṃ ṛksāme, vākprāṇādyātmake cādhyātmamanukramyāha- 'tasyarkca sāma ca geṣṇau' ityadhidaivatam / tathādhyātmamapi- ' yāvamuṣya geṣṇau tau geṣṇau' iti / tacca sarvātmana evopapadyate / tadya ime vīṇāyāṃ gāyantyetaṃ te gāyanti tasmātte dhanasanayaḥ'
sarvakāraṇattvāttu vikāradharmairapi kaiścidviśiṣṭaḥ parameśvara upāsyatvena nirdiśyate- 'sarvakarmā sarvakāmaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvarasaḥ'
asti cādityādiśarīrābhimānibhyo jīvebhyo 'nya īśvaro 'ntaryāmī, 'ya āditye tiṣṭhannādityāntaro yamādityo na veda yasyādityaḥ śarīraṃ ya ādityamantaro yamayatyeṣa ta ātmāntaryāmyamṛtaḥ'
idamāmananti- 'asya lokasya kā gatirityākāśa iti hovāca sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtānyākāśādeva samutpadyanta ākāśaṃ pratyastaṃ yantyākāśo hyevaibhyo jyāyānākāśaḥ parāyaṇam'
yatra vākyaśeṣavaśādasādhāraṇaśravaṇādvā nirdhāritaṃ brahma bhavati, yathā- 'yadeṣa ākāśa ānando na syāt'
iti 'ākāśo vai nāma nāmarūpayornirvahitā te yadantarā tadbrahma'
vijñāyate hi- 'tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ / ākāśādvāyuḥ / vāyoragniḥ'
jyāyastvaṃ hyānāpekṣikaṃ paramātmanyevaikasminnāmnātam- 'jyāyānpṛthivyā jyāyamantarikṣājjyāyāndivo jyāyānebhyo lokebhyaḥ'
api cāntavattvadoṣeṇa śālāvatyasya pakṣaṃ ninditvā, anantaṃ kiñcidvaktukāmena jaivalinā ākāśaḥ parigṛhītaḥ, taṃ cākāśamudgīthe saṃpādyopasaṃharati- 'sa eṣa parovarīyānudgīthaḥ sa eṣo 'nantaḥ'

udgīthe- 'prastotaryā devatā prastāvamanvāyattā' ityupakramya śrūyate- katamā sā devateti prāṇā iti hovāca sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtāni prāṇamevābhisaṃviśanti prāṇamabhyujjihate saiṣā devatā prastāvamanvāyattā'
idamāmananti- 'atha yadataḥ paro jyotirdīpyate viśvataḥpṛṣṭeṣu sarvataḥpṛṣṭeṣvanuttameṣūttameṣu lokeṣvidaṃ vāva tadyadidamasminnantaḥpuruṣe jyotiḥ'
yatra tu guṇaviśeṣasaṃbandhaṃ pratīkaviśeṣasaṃbandhaṃ vā brahmopadiśyate, tatra saṃsāragocarāṇyevoccāvacāni phalāni dṛśyante- 'annādo vasudāno vidante vasu ya evaṃ veda'
atha yaduktaṃ pūrvasminnapi vākye na brahmabhihitamiti, 'gāyatrī vā idaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ yadidaṃ kiñca'
iti brahmaśabdaḥ so 'pi chandasaḥ prakṛtatvācchandoviṣaya eva 'ya etāmevaṃ brahmopaniṣadaṃ veda'
tadyathā- 'te vā ete pañcānye pañcānye daśa santastatkṛtam' ityupakramyāha 'saiṣā virāḍannādi'
anayā hi ṛcā svarasena brahmaivābhidhīyate, 'pādo 'sya sarvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi'
'tadyo yo devānāṃ pratyabudhyata sa eva tadabhavat'
śarīradhāraṇaṃ ca mukhyaprāṇasya dharmaḥ, prāṇasaṃvāde vāgādīnprāṇānprakṛtya- 'tānvariṣṭhaḥ prāṇa uvāca mā mohamāpadyathāhamevaitatpañcadhātmānaṃ pravibhajyaitadprāṇamavaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmi'

idamāmnāyate- 'sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma tajjalāniti śānta upāsīta / atha khalu kratumayaḥ puruṣo yathākraturasmiṃlloke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati sa kratuṃ kurvīta', 'manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīro bhārūpaḥ'
tathāca brahmaviṣaye śrutismṛtī bhavataḥ- 'tvaṃ strī tvaṃ kumāra uta vā kumārī / tvaṃ jīrṇo daṇḍena vañcasi tvaṃ jāto bhavasi viśvatomukhaḥ'
itaśca na śārīro manomayatvādiguṇaḥ, yasmātkarmakartṛvyapadeśo bhavati 'etamitaḥ pretyābhisaṃbhavitāsmi'
smṛtiśca śārīraparamātmanorbhedaṃ darśayati- 'īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśer'juna tiṣṭati / bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā' /
tathā smṛtirapi- 'kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata'
nahi parasmādātmano 'nyaḥ kaścidātmā saṃsārī vidyate, 'nānyo 'to 'sti vijñātā'
itaśca paramātmaivehāttā bhavitumarhati, yatkāraṇaṃ prakaraṇamidaṃ paramatmanaḥ, 'na jāyate mriyate vā vipaścit'
kaṭhavallīṣveva paṭhyate- 'ṛtaṃ pibantau loke guhāṃ praviṣṭau parame parārdhe / chāyātapau brahmavido vadanti pañṭagnayo ye ca triṇāciketāḥ'
tadapīha pratipāditavyaṃ, 'yeyaṃ prete vicikitsā manuṣye 'stītyeke nāyamastīti caike / etadvidyāmanuśiṣṭastvayāhaṃ varāṇāmeṣa varastṛtīyaḥ'
tadapīha pratipādayitavyaṃ, 'anyatra dharmādanyatrādharmadanyatrāsmātkṛtākṛtāt / anyatra bhūtācca bhavyācca yattatpaśyasi tadvada'
guhāhitatvaṃ tu śrutismṛtiṣvasakṛtparamātmana eva dṛśyate- 'guhāhitaṃ gahvareṣṭhaṃ purāṇam'
tathā 'taṃ durdarśa gūḍhamanupraviṣṭhaṃ purāṇam / adhyātmayogādhigamena devaṃ matvā dhīro harṣaśokau jahāti'
'ya eṣo 'kṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyata eṣa ātmeti hovācaitadamṛtamabhayametadbrahmeti / etadyapyasminsarpirvodakaṃ vā siñcati vartmani eva gacchati'

amṛtatvābhayatve ca tasminnasakṛcchrutau śrūyete / tathā parameśvarānurūpametadakṣisthānam / yathāhi parameśvaraḥ sarvadoṣairaliptaḥ, apahatapāpmatvādiśravaṇāt / tathākṣisthānaṃ sarvaleparahimupadiṣṭaṃ, 'tadyadyapyasminsarpirvodakaṃ vā siñcati vartmani eva gacchati' iti śruteḥ / saṃyadvāmatvādiguṇopadeśaśca tasminnavakalpate / 'etaṃ saṃyaddhāma ityācakṣate etaṃ hi sarvāṇi vāmānyabhisaṃyanti' / 'eṣa u eva vāmanīreṣa hi sarvāṇi vāmāni nayati' / ' eṣa u eva bhāmānīreṣa hi sarveṣu lokeṣu bhāti'
santi hyanyānyapi pṛthivyādīni sthānānyasya nirdiṣṭāni- 'yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhan'

'sthānādivyapadeśāt' ityādigrahaṇenaitaddarśayati- na kevalaṃ sthānamevaikamanucitaṃ brahmaṇo nirdiśyamānaṃ dṛśyate, kiṃ tarhi nāmarūpamityevañjātīyakamapyanāmarūpasya brahmaṇo 'nucitaṃ nirdiśyamānaṃ dṛśyate- 'tasyoditi nāma' 'hiraṇyaśmaśruḥ'
tatredaṃ prativacanam- 'yadvāva kaṃ tadeva khaṃ yadeva khaṃ tadeva kaṃ'
'yathā puṣkarapalāśā āpo na śliṣyanta evamevaṃvidi pāpaṃ karma na śliṣyate'
tasmātprakṛtasyaiva brahmaṇo 'kṣisthānatāṃ saṃyadvāmatvādiguṇatāṃ coktvārcirādikāṃ tadvido gatiṃ vakṣyāmītyupakramate- 'ya eṣo 'kṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyata eṣa ātmeti hovāca'

itaścākṣisthānaḥ puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ, yasmācchrutopaniṣatkasya śrutarahasyavijñānasya brahmavido yā gatirdevayānākhyā prasiddhā śrutau- 'athottareṇa tapasā brahmacaryeṇa śraddhayā vidyayātmānamanviṣyādityamabhijayanta etadvai prāṇānāmāyatanametadamṛtamabhayametatparāyaṇametasmānna punarāvartante'
smṛtāvapi- 'agnirjyotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam / tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ'

'atha yadu caivāsmiñchavyaṃ kurvanti yadi ca nārciṣamevābhisaṃbhavanti' ityupakramya 'ādityāccandramasaṃ candramaso vidyutaṃ tatpuruṣo 'mānavaḥ sa enānbrahma gamayatyeva devapatho brahmapatha etena pratipadyamānā imaṃ mānavamāvarte nāvartante'

amṛtatvādayo 'pi na saṃbhavanti, utpattipralayaśravaṇāt / amaratvamapi devānāṃ cirakālāvasthānāpekṣam / aiśvaryamapi parameśvarāyattaṃ na svābhāvikam / bhīṣāsmādvātaḥ pavate bhīṣodeti sūryaḥ / bhīṣāsmādagniścendraśca mṛtyurdhāvati pañcamaḥ'

'ya imaṃ ca lokaṃ paraṃ ca lokaṃ sarvāṇi ca bhūtāni yo 'ntaro yamayati' ityupakramya śrūyate- 'yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhanpṛthivyā antaro yaṃ pṛthivī na veda yasya pṛthivī śarīraṃ yaḥ pṛthivīmantaro yamayatyeṣa ta ātmāntaryāmyamṛtaḥ'
apicobhaye 'pi hi śākhinaḥ kāṇvā mādhyandinānāścāntaryāmiṇo bhedenainaṃ śārīraṃ pṛthivyādivadadhiṣṭhānatvena niyamyatvena cādhīyate- 'yo vijñāne tiṣṭhan'
'ko na ātmā kiṃ brahma' iti, 'ātmānamevemaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ saṃpratyadhyeṣi tameva no brūhi'

'yastvetamevaṃ prādeśamātramabhivimānamātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramupāḥse sa sarveṣu lokeṣu bhūteṣu sarveṣvātmasvannamatti tasya ha vā etasyātmano vaiśvānarasya mūrdhaiva sutejāścakṣurviśvarūpaḥ prāṇaḥ pṛthagvartmātmā saṃdeho bahulo bastireva rayiḥ pṛthivyeva pādāvura eva vedirlomāni barhirhṛdayaṃ gārhapatyo mano 'nvāhāryapacana āsyamāvahanīyaḥ'
athavā jāṭharavaiśvānaropādhibhiḥ parameśvara iha draṣṭavyatvenopadiśyate, 'manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīro bhārūpaḥ'
śrutiprasiddho vā vāyuḥ syāt, 'vāyurvai gautama tatsūtraṃ vāyunā vai gautama sūtreṇāyaṃ ca lokaḥ sarvāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃdṛbdhāni bhavanti'

tasyāpi bhoktṛtvādbhogyaṃ prapañcaṃ pratyāyatanatvopapatterityevaṃ prāpta idamāha- dyubhvādyāyatanamiti / dyauśca bhūśca dyubhuvau dyubhuvāvādī yasya tadidaṃ dyubhvādi / yadetadasminvākye dyauḥ pṛthivyantarikṣaṃ manaḥ prāṇā ityevamasmākaṃ jagadotatvena nirdiṣṭaṃ tasyāyatanaṃ paraṃ brahma bhavitumarhati / kutaḥ / svaśabdāt, ātmaśabdādityarthaḥ / ātmaśabdo hīha bhavati- 'tamevaikaṃ jānatha ātmānam' iti / ātmaśabdaśca paramātmaparigrahe samyagavakalpate nārthāntaraparigrahe / kvacicca svaśabdenaiva brahmaṇa āyatanatvaṃ śrūyate-' sanmūlāḥ somyemāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sadāyatanāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ'
'sa yathā saindhavaghano 'nantaro 'bāhyaḥ kṛtsno rasaghana evaivaṃ vā are 'yamātmānantaro 'bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñānaghana eva'
tacca śrutyantare brahmaṇo dṛṣṭam- 'tameva dhīro vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvati brāhmaṇaḥ / nānudhyāyādvahūñśabdānvāco viglāpanaṃ hi tat'
tathā 'śrutaṃ hyeva me bhagavaddṛśebhyastarati śokamātmaviditi so 'haṃ bhagavaḥ śocāmi taṃ mā bhagavāñśokasya pāraṃ tārayatu'
'atraiṣa devaḥ svapnānna paśyatyatha yadetasmiñśarīre sukhaṃ bhavati'

iti śruteḥ / kathaṃ punaḥ prāṇaṃ bhūmānaṃ manyamānasya tarati śokamātmavit ityātmavividiṣayā prakaraṇasyotthānamupapadyate / prāṇa evehātmā vivakṣita iti brūmaḥ / tathāhi-' prāṇo ha pitā prāṇo mātā prāṇo bhrātā prāṇaḥ svasā prāṇa ācāryaḥ prāṇo brāhmaṇaḥ'
iti copakramyopasaṃharati- 'tasmai mṛditakaṣāyāya tamasaḥ pāraṃ darśayati bhagavānsanatkumāraḥ'
yata āha- 'eṣo 'sya parama ānanda etasyaivānandasyānyāni bhūtāni mātrāmupajīvanti'
'kasminnu khalvākāśa otaśca protaśceti / sa hovācaitadvai tadakṣaraṃ gārgi brāhmaṇā abhivadantyasthūlamanaṇu'
tatrākṣarasamāmnāya ityādāvakṣaraśabdasya varṇe prasiddhatvāt prasiddhyatikramasya cāyuktatvāt 'oṅkāra evedaṃ sarvam'
praśāsanaṃ hīha śrūyate- 'etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ'
yadanyadbrahmaṇo 'kṣaraśabdavācyamihāśaṅkyate tadbhāvādidamambarāntavidhāraṇamakṣaraṃ vyāvartayati śrutiḥ- 'tadvā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyadṛṣṭaṃ daṣṭraśrutaṃ śrotramataṃ mantravijñātaṃ vijñātṛ'
'etadvai satyakāma paraṃ cāparaṃ ca brahma yadoṅkārastasmādvidvānetenaivāyatanenaikataramanveti iti prakṛtya śrūyate- 'yaḥ punaretaṃ trimātreṇomithyetenaivākṣareṇa paraṃ puruṣamabhidhyāyīta'
'atha yadidamasminbrahmapure daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ veśma daharo 'sminnantarākāśastasminyadantastadanveṣṭavyaṃ tadbhāva vijijñāsitavyam' /
'sa brūyādyavānvā ayamākāśastāvāneṣo 'ntarhṛdaya ākāśa ubhe asmindyāvāpṛthivī antareva samāhite'
'sa vā ayaṃ puruṣaḥ sarvāsu pūrṣu puriśayaḥ'
'tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyata evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate'
itaśca parameśvara eva daharaḥ, yasmāddaharavākyaśeṣe parameśvarasyaiva pratipādakau gatiśabdau bhavataḥ- 'imāḥ sarvāḥ prajā aharahargacchantya etaṃ brahmalokaṃ na vindanti'
tathā hyaharaharjīvānāṃ suṣuptavasthāyāṃ brahmaviṣayaṃ gamanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrutyantare- 'satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati'

'daharo 'sminnantarākāśaḥ' iti hi prakṛtyākāśaupamyapūrvakaṃ tasminsarvasamādhānamuktvā tāṃ sminneva cātmaśabdaṃ prayujyāpahatapāpmatvādiguṇayogaṃ copaduśya tamevānativṛttaprakaraṇaṃ nirdiśati- 'atha ya ātmā sa seturvidhṛtireṣalokānāmasaṃbhedāya'

yadi vākyaśeṣabalena dahara iti parameśvaraḥ parigṛhyetāstītarasyāpi jīvasya vākyaśeṣe parāmarśaḥ - 'atha ya eṣa saṃprasādo 'smāccharīrātsamutthāya paraṃ jyotirūpasaṃpadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyata eṣa ātmeti hovāca'
tatrahi 'ya ātmāpahatapāpmā' ityapahatapāpmatvādiguṇakamātmānamanveṣṭavyaṃ vijijñāsitavyaṃ ca pratijñāya 'ya eṣo 'kṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyata eṣa ātmā'
iti ca tameva punaḥ punaḥ parāmṛśya 'ya eṣa svapne mahīyamānaścaratyeṣa ātmā'

iti 'tadyatraitatsuptaḥ samastaḥ saṃprasannaḥ svapnaṃ na vijānātyeṣa ātmā' iti ca jīvamevāvasthāntaragataṃ vyācaṣṭe / tasyaiva cāpahatapāpmatvādi darśayati- 'etadamṛtamabhayametadbrahma' iti / nāhaṃ khalvayamevaṃ saṃpratyātmānaṃ jānātyayamahamasmīti no evemāni bhūtāni'
tathā vivekāvivekamātreṇaivātmano 'śarīratvaṃ saśarīratvaṃ ca, mantravarṇāt 'aśarīraṃ śarīreṣu'
iti, 'śarīrastho 'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate'
atha yo daharavākyaśeṣe jīvaparāmarśo darśitaḥ - 'atha ya eṣa saṃprasādaḥ'
pṛṣṭaṃ ceha brahma 'anyatra dharmādanyatrādharmādanyatrāsmātkṛtākṛtāt / anyatra bhūtācca bhavyācca yattatpaśyasi tadvada'
apicaiṣāṃ vidyāgrahaṇārthaṃ brahmacaryādi darśayati- 'ekaśataṃ ha vai varṣāṇi maghavānprajāpatau brahmacaryamuvāsa'
, 'bhṛgurvai vāruṇiḥ / varuṇaṃ pitaramupasasāra / adhīhi bhagavo brahma'
tathāhi-'kati devāḥ' ityupakramya 'trayaśca trī ca śatā trayaśca trī ca sahasrā' iti nirucya 'katama te' ityasyāṃ pṛcchāyām 'mahimāna evaiṣāmete trayastriṃśattveva devāḥ'
'tathā agniḥ pādo vāyuḥ pāda ādityaḥ pādo diśaḥ pādaḥ'
brahmavidyāṃ ca prakṛtya bhavati darśanaṃ śrautaṃ devādyadhikārasya sūcakam- 'tadyo yo devānāṃ pratyabudhyata sa eva tadabhavattatharṣīṇāṃ tathā manuṣyāṇām'
iti / 'te hocurhanta tamātmānamanvicchāmo yamātmānamanviṣya sarvāṃśca lokānāpnoti sarvāṃśca kāmān' iti / 'indro ha vai devānāmabhipravrāja virocana'surāṇām'
śrutiśca yogamāhātmyaṃ prakhyāpayati- 'pṛthivyaptejo 'nilakhe samutthite pañcātmake yogaguṇe pravṛtte / na tasya rogo na jarā na mṛtyuḥ prāptasya yogāgnimayaṃ śarīram''
saṃvargavidyāyāṃ hi jānaśrutiṃ pautrāyaṇaṃ śuśrūṣuṃ śūdraśabdena parāmṛśati- 'aha hāretvā śūdra tavaiva saha gobhirastu'

itaśca na jātiśūdro jānaśrutiḥ / yatkāraṇaṃ prakaraṇanirūpaṇena kṣatriyatvamasyottaratra caitrarathenābhipratāriṇā kṣatriyeṇa samabhivyāhārādgamyate / uttaratra hi saṃvargavidyāvākyaśeṣe caitrarathirabhipratārī kṣatriyaḥ saṃkīrtyate- ' atha ha śaunakaṃ ca kapoyamabhipratāraṇaṃ ca kākṣaseniṃ pariviṣyamāṇau brahmacārī vibhikṣe'
' brahmaparā brahmaniṣṭhāḥ paraṃ brahmānveṣamāṇā eṣa ha vai tatsarvaṃ vakṣyatīti te ha samitpāṇayo bhagavantaṃ pippalādamupasannāḥ'
yatsatyavacanena śūdratvābhāve nirdhārite jābālaṃ gautama upanetumanuśāsituṃ ca pravavṛte 'naitadbrāhmaṇo vivaktumarhati samidhaṃ somyāharopa tvā neṣye na satyādagāḥ'

iti mumukṣorādityaprāptirabhihitā / tasmātprasiddhameva tejo jyotiḥśabdamiti / evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ - parameva brahma jyotiḥśabdam / kasmāt / darśanāt / tasya hīha prakaraṇe vaktavyatvenānuvṛttirdṛśyate, ' ya ātmāpahatapāpmā'
'ākāśo vai nāma nāmarūpayornirvahitā te yadantarā tadbrahma tadamṛtaṃ sa ātmā'
bṛhadāraṇyake ṣaṣṭe prapāṭhake 'katama ātmeti yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu hṛdyantarjyotiḥ puruṣaḥ'
upasaṃhāre ca sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmā yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu'
suṣuptau tāvat 'ayaṃ puruṣaḥ prājñenātmanā saṃpariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntaram'

saṃyataistvadhvanaḥ pāraṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padamāpnoti darśayitvā, kiṃ tadadhvanaḥ pāraṃ viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padamityasyāmākāṅkṣāyāṃ, tebhya eva prakṛtebhya indriyādibhyaḥ paratvena paramātmānamadhvanaḥ pāraṃ viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ darśayati- 'indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaśca paraṃ manaḥ / manasastu parā buddhirbuddherātmā mahānparaḥ / mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktātpuruṣaḥ paraḥ / puruṣānna paraṃ kiñcitsā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ'
tathāca 'eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhātmā na prakāśate / dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ' /
iti vaiṣṇavasya paramapadasya duravagamatvamuktvā tadavagamārthaṃ yogaṃ darśayati- 'yacchedvāṅmanasī prājñastadyacchejjñāna ātmani / jñānamātmani mahati niyacchettadyacchecchānta ātmani' /
tadetadavyaktaṃ kvacidākāśaśabdanirdiṣṭam- 'etasminnu khalvakṣare gārgyākāśa otaśca protaśca'
kvacinmāyeti sūcitam- 'māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyānmāyinaṃ tu maheśvaram'
sūkṣmaṃ yaduttaratra vakṣyate- 'tadantarapratipattau raṃhati saṃpariṣvaktaḥ praśnanirūpaṇābhyām'

śrūyate hyuttaratrāvyaktaśabdoditasya pradhānasya jñeyatvavacanam- 'aśabdamasparśamarūpamavyayaṃ tathārasaṃ nityamagandhavacca yat / anādyanantaṃ mahataḥ paraṃ dhruvaṃ nicāyya taṃ mṛtyumukhātpramucyate' /
tatra tāvat 'sa tvamagniṃ svargyamadhyeṣi mṛtyo prabrūhi taṃ śraddadhānāya mahyam'
prativacanamapi 'lokādimamagniṃ tamuvāca tasmai yā iṣṭakāyāvatīrvā yathā vā'

tathā jīvavīṣayasyāstitvanāstitvapraśnasyānantaram 'anyaṃ varaṃ naciketo vṛṇīṣva' ityārabhya mṛtyunā taistaiḥ kāmaiḥ pralobhyamāno 'pi naciketā yadā na cacāla, tadainaṃ mṛtyurabhyudayanīḥśreyasavibhāgapradarśanena vidyāvidyāvibhāgapradarśanena ca 'vidyābhīpsinaṃ naciketasaṃ manye na tvā kāmā bahavo 'lolupanta'
vākyaśeṣe 'pi 'māyāṃ tu prakṛti vidyānmāyinaṃ tu maheśvaram' iti 'yo yoniṃ yonimadhitiṣṭhatyekaḥ'
janavacanaśca puruṣaśabdaḥ prāṇeṣu prayuktaḥ 'te vā ete pañca brahmapuruṣāḥ'
tathā kvacidasatpūrvikā sṛṣṭiḥ paṭhyate- 'asadvā idamagra āsīttato vai sadājayata'

kvacidasadvādanirākaraṇena satpūrvikā prakriyā pratijñāyate- 'taddhaika āhurasadevedamagra āsīt' ityupakramya 'kutastu khalu somyaivaṃ syāditi hovāca kathamasataḥ sajjāyeteti sattveva somyedamagra āsīt'
kvacitsvayaṅkartṛkaiva vyākriyā jagato nigadyate- 'taddhedaṃ tarhyavyākṛtamāsīttannāmarūpābhyāmeva vyākriyata'
darśayati ca sṛṣṭyādiprapañcasya brahmapratipattyarthatām- 'annena somya śuṅgenāpo mūlamanvicchadbhiḥ somya śuṅgena tejo mulamanviccha tejasā somya śuṅgena sanmūlamanviccha'
'katama eko deva iti prāṇa iti sa brahma tyadityācakṣate
prāṇaśabdo 'pi brahmaviṣayo dṛṣṭaḥ 'prāṇabandhanaṃ hi somya manaḥ'

apicaivameke śākhino vājasaneyino 'sminneva bālākyajātaśatrusaṃvāde spaṣṭaṃ vijñānamayaśabdena jīvamāmnāya tadvyatiriktaṃ paramātmānamāmananti- 'ya eṣa vijñānamayapuruṣaḥ kvaiṣa tadābhūtkuta etadāgāt'

bṛhadāraṇyake maitreyībrāhmaṇe 'dhīyate- 'na vā are patyuḥ kāmāya' ityupakramya 'na vā are sarvasya kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavatyātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavatyātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyo maitreyyātmano vā are darśanena śravaṇena matyā vijñānenedaṃ sarvaṃ viditam' /
śrutiścaivaṃ bhavati- 'eṣa saṃprasādo 'smāccharīrātsamutthāya paraṃ jyotirupasaṃpadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate'
idamatra pratijñātam- 'ātmani vidite sarvaṃ viditaṃ bhavati' 'idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā'
nanūcchedābhidhānametat 'etebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānuvinaśyati na pretya saṃjñāsti'
apica 'yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati taditara itaraṃ paśyati'
bhedadarśanāpavādācca 'anyo 'sāvanyo 'hamasmīti na sa veda yathā paśuḥ'
nahi 'satyaṃ jñānamantaṃ brahma / yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyām'
brahma ca naivaṃlakṣaṇamavagamyate 'niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śāntaṃ niravadyaṃ nirañjanam'
pratijñā tāvat- 'uta tamādeśamaprākṣyo yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavatyamataṃ matamavijñātaṃ vijñātam'
tathā 'ekena lohamaṇinā sarvaṃ lohamayaṃ vijñātaṃ syāt' 'ekena nakhanikṛntanena sarvaṃ kārṣṇāyasaṃ vijñātaṃ syāt'
'sa yathā dundubherhanyamānasya na bāhyāñśabdāñśaknuyādgrahaṇāya dundubhestu grahaṇena dundubhyāghātasya vā śabdo gṛhītaḥ'
itaśca prakṛtirbrahma, yatkāraṇaṃ sākṣādbrahmaiva kāraṇamupādāyobhau prabhavapralayāvāmnāyate- 'sarvāṇi ha vā imāni bhūtānyākāśādeva samutpadyante / ākāśaṃ pratyastaṃ yanti'

pūrvasiddho 'pi hi sannātmā viśeṣeṇa vikārātmanā pariṇamayāmāsātmānamiti / vikārātmanā ca pariṇāmo mṛdādyāsu prakṛtiṣūpalabdhaḥ / svayamiti ca viśeṣaṇānnimittāntarānapekṣatvamapi pratīyate / pariṇāmāditi vā pṛthaksūtram / tasyaiṣor'thaḥ - itaśca prakṛtirbrahma, yatkāraṇaṃ brahmaṇa eva vikārātmanā pariṇāmaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyenāmnāyate 'sacca tyaccābhavat / niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca'
śrutiśca bhavati- 'ṛṣiṃ prasūtaṃ kapilaṃ yastamagre jñānairbibharti jāyamānaṃ ca paśyet'
bhagavadgītāsu ca- 'ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā'
śrutiśca sarvātmatāyāṃ bhavati- 'yasminsarvāṇi bhūtānyātmaivābhūdvijānataḥ / tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śokaḥ ekatvamanupaśyataḥ'
samyagdarśanābhyupāyo hi yogo vede vihitaḥ 'śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ'
śrutirhi vaidikādātmaikatvavijñānādanyanniḥśreyasasādhanaṃ vārayati 'tameva viditvātimṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate 'yanāya'
indriyaviṣayāpi 'te heme prāṇā ahaṃśreyase vivadamānā brahma jagmuḥ'
prāṇasaṃvādavākyaśeṣe ca 'te ha prāṇāḥ prajāpatiṃ pitarametyocuḥ'
tathāca śrutiḥ - 'naiṣā tarkeṇa matirāpaneyā proktānyenaiva sujñānāya preṣṭha'
'na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ / ahamādirhi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ'
śrutiścātra bhavati- 'imāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sati saṃpadya na viduḥ sati saṃpadyāmaha iti ta iha vyāghro vā siṃho vā vṛko vā varāho vā kīṭo vā pataṅgo vā daṃśo vā maśako vā yadyadbhavanti tadā bhavanti'
ekavijñānena sarvavijñānaṃ pratijñāya dṛṣṭāntāpekṣāyāmucyate- 'yathā somyaikena mṛtpiṇḍena sarvaṃ mṛnmayaṃ vijñātaṃ syādvācārambhaṇaṃ vikāro nāmadheyaṃ mṛttiketyeva satyam'
punaśca tejobannānāṃ brahmakāryatāmuktvā tejobannakāryāṇāṃ tejobannavyatirekeṇābhāvaṃ bravīti- 'apāgādagneragnitvaṃ vācārambhaṇaṃ vikāro nāmadheyaṃ trīṇi rūpāṇītyeva satyam'
ārambhaṇaśabdādibhya ityādiśabdāt 'aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasi'
na ceyamavagatirnopapadyata iti śakyaṃ vaktum, 'taddhāsya vijajñau'
kūṭasthabrahmātmavijñānādeva hi phalaṃ darśayati śāstram- 'sa eṣa neti netyātmā' ityupakramya 'abhayaṃ vai janaka prāpto 'si'
tābhyāmanyaḥ sarvajña īśvaraḥ 'ākāśo vai nāma nāmarūpayornirvahitā te yadantarā tadbrahma'
tathācoktam- 'yatra nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti sa bhūmā'
vyavahārāvasthāyāṃ tūktaḥ śrutāvapīśvarādivyavahāraḥ 'eṣa sarveśvara eṣa bhūtādhipatireṣa bhūtapāla eṣa seturvidhāraṇa eṣāṃ lokānāmasaṃbhedāya'
iti / tathāceśvaragītāsvapi- 'īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśer'juna tiṣṭhati / bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā'
nanu kvacidasattvamapi prāgutpatteḥ kāryasya vyapadiśati śrutiḥ - 'asadevedamagra āsīt
'taddhaika āhurasadevedamagra āsīt' iti cāsatpakṣamupakṣipya 'kathamasataḥ sajjāyeta' ityākṣipya 'sadeva somyedamagra āsīt'
ataśca kṛtsnasya jagato brahmakāryatvāttadananyatvācca siddhaiṣā śrautī pratijñā 'yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavatyamataṃ matamavijñātaṃ vijñātam'
itarasya śārīrasya brahmātmatvaṃ vyapadiśati śrutiḥ - 'sa ātmā tattvamasi śvetaketo'
itarasya ca brahmaṇaḥ śārīrātmatvaṃ vyapadiśati 'tatsṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśat'
'ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ''
niravayavaṃ tu brahma śrutibhyo 'vagamyate- 'niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śāntaṃ niravadyaṃ nirañjanam'

yathaiva hi brahmaṇo jagadutpattiḥ śrūyata evaṃ vikāravyatirekeṇāpi brahmaṇo 'vastānaṃ śrūyate, prakṛtivikārayorbhedena vyapadeśāt 'seyaṃ devataikṣata hantāhamimāstisro devatā anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi'
'sa eṣa neti netyātmā' ityupakramyāha- 'abhayaṃ vai janaka prāpto 'si'
yata ātmanyapyekasminsvapnadṛśi svarūpānupamardenaivānekākārā sṛṣṭiḥ paṭhyate- 'na tatra rathā na rathayogo na panthāno bhavantyatha rathārathayogānpathaḥ sṛjate'
yathāhi darśayati śrutiḥ sarvaśaktiyogaṃ parasyā devatāyāḥ - 'sarvakarmā sarvakāmaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvamidamabhyātto 'vākyanādaraḥ'
, 'etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgisūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ'
syādetat vikaraṇāṃ parāṃ devatāṃ śāsti śāstram- 'acakṣuṣkamaśrotramavāgamanāḥ'
tathāca śāstram- 'apāṇipādo javano grahītā paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇaḥ'
bhavati ca lokaprasiddhyanuvādinī śrutiḥ- 'na vā are sarvasya kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavatyātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavati'
'puṇyo vai puṇyena karmaṇā bhavati pāpaḥ pāpena'
smṛtirapi prāṇikarmaviśeṣāpekṣameveśvarasyānugrahītatvaṃ ca darśayati- 'ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham'
smṛtāvapyanāditvaṃ saṃsārasyopalabhyate- 'na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā'
, 'etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi prācyonyā nadyaḥ syandante'
tatra yattāvaducyeta yo 'sau nārāyaṇaḥ paro 'vyaktātprasiddhaḥ paramātmā sarvātmā sa ātmānātmānamanekadhā vyūhyāvasthita iti, tanna nirākriyate, 'sa ekadhā bhavati tridhā bhavati'
taittirīyakā hi samāmananti- 'satyaṃ jñānamantaṃ brahma' iti prakṛtya 'tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ'
kathaṃ punarekasya saṃbhūtaśabdasya 'tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ'
yathaikasyāpi brahmaśabdasya 'tapasā brahma vijijñāsasva, tapo brahma'
iti, 'ātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāta idaṃ sarvaṃ viditam'
ityevaṃ kāryajātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pradarśyāvyatirekaṃ pradarśayanti- 'aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam'
tathāhi- prativedāntaṃ te te śabdāstena tena dṛṣṭāntena tāmeva pratijñāṃ khyapayanti 'idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā'
yaduktamaśruterna viyadutpadyata iti, tadayuktaṃ, viyadutpattiviṣayaśrutyantarasya darśitatvāt 'tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ'
tejaḥsargasya taittirīyake tṛtīyatvaśravaṇāt 'tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ / ākāśādvāyuḥ / vāyoragniḥ'

naca svakāryāpekṣayedaṃ vastvekadeśaviṣayaṃ sarvavijñānamekamevādvitīyatāvadhāraṇaṃ ceti nyāyyaṃ, mṛdādiṣvapi hi tatsaṃbhavānna tadapūrvavadupanyasitavyaṃ bhavati 'śvetaketo yannu somyedaṃ mahāmanā anūcānamānī stabdho 'syuta tamādeśamaprākṣyo 'yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati'
yathā ca brahma na sthūlādibhiḥ pṛthivyādisvabhāvaiḥ svabhāvavat, 'asthūlamanaṇu'
'sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipo na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhipaḥ'
ityādyanukramya 'bhavati bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ'
tathāhi śāstram- 'yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhan pṛthivyā antaro yaṃ pṛthivī na veda yasya pṛthivī śarīraṃ yaḥ pṛthivīmantaro yamayati'
'buddhiṃ tu sārathiṃ viddhi manaḥ pragrahameva ca / indriyāṇi hayānāhuḥ'
'annamayaṃ hi somya mana oṣadhayaḥ prāṇastejomayī vāk'
śrūyate ca- 'jīvāpetaṃ vāva kiledaṃ mriyate na jīvo mriyate'
'sa vā ayaṃ puruṣo jāyamānaḥ śarīramabhisaṃpadyamānaḥ sa utkrāman mriyamāṇaḥ
apica 'yathāgneḥ kṣudrā visphuliṅgā vyuccārantyevamevāsmādātmanaḥ sarve prāṇāḥ'
tathāca śāstram- 'sa vā ayamātmā brahma vijñānamayo manomayaḥ prāṇamayaścakṣurmayaḥ śrotramayaḥ'
tathāca darśayati- 'prajñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānu vinaśyati na pretya saṃjñāsti'

tathopādhipralaya evāyaṃ nātmavilaya ityetadapyatraiva 'mā bhagavānmohāntamāpīpadanna vā ahamimaṃ vijānāmi na pretya saṃjñāsti' iti praśnapūrvakaṃ pratipādayati- 'na vā are 'haṃ mohaṃ bravīmyavināśī vā are 'yamātmānucchittidharmā mātrāsaṃsargastvasya bhavati'
suṣuptaṃ prakṛtya 'yadvai tanna paśyati paśyanvai tanna paśyati- nahi draṣṭurddaṣṭerviparilopo vidyate 'vināśitvānna tu taddvitīyamasti tato 'nyadvibhaktaṃ yatpaśyet'
'sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmā yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu
tathonmānamapi jīvasyāṇimānaṃ gamayati- 'bālāgraśatabhāgasya śatadhā kalpitasya ca / bhāgo jīvaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ'
, 'katama ātmeti yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu hṛdyantarjyotiḥ puruṣaḥ'
hṛdayāyatanatvamaṇuparimāṇatvaṃ cātmano 'bhidhāya tasyaiva 'ā lomasya ā nakhāgrebhyaḥ'
tathāca 'sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmā yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu'
tathāca- 'bālāgraśatabhāgasya śatadhā kalpitasya ca / bhāgo jīvaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sa cānantyāya kalpate'
tathotkrāntyādīnāmapyupādhyāyattatāṃ darśayati- 'kasminnvahamutkrānta utkrānto bhaviṣyāmi kasminvā pratiṣṭhite pratiṣṭhāsyāmīti'
tathāhi śāstraṃ darśayati- 'yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu hṛdyantarjyotiḥ puruṣaḥ sa samānaḥ sannubhau lokāvanusaṃcarati dhyāyatīva lelāyatīva'
'satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati svamapīto bhavati'

yathā loke puṃstvādīni bījātmanā vidyamānānyeva bālyādiṣvanupalabhyamānānyavidyamānavadabhipreyamāṇāni yauvanādiṣvāvirbhavanti, nāvidyamānānyutpadyante ṣaṇḍādīnāmapi tadutpattiprasaṅgāt, evamayamapi buddhisaṃbandhaḥ śaktyātmanā vidyamāna eva suṣuptapralayayoḥ punaḥ prabodhaprasavayorāvirbhavati / evaṃ hyetadyujyate / nahyākasmikī kasyacidutpattiḥ saṃbhavati / atiprasaṅgāt / darśayati ca suṣuptādutthānamavidyātmakabījasadbhāvakāritam- 'sati saṃpadya na viduḥ sati saṃpadyamāha' iti ta iha vyāghro vā saṃho vā'
tathāca śrutiḥ - 'anyatrātmanā abhūvaṃ nādarśamanyatramanā abhūvaṃ nāśrauṣam'
kāmādayaścāsya vṛttaya iti darśayati 'kāmaḥ saṃkalpo vicikitsā śraddhāśraddhā dhṛtiradhṛtirhīrbhīrityetatsarvaṃ mana eva'
itaśca jīvasya kartṛtvaṃ, yajjīvaprakriyāyāṃ saṃdhye sthāne vihāramupadiśati- 'sa īyate 'mṛto yatra kāmam'
tathā hyanyatra buddhivivakṣāyāṃ vijñānaśabdasya karaṇavibhaktinirdeśo dṛśyate 'tadeṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ vijñānena vijñānamādāya'
yo 'pyayamaupaniṣadātmapratipattiprayojanaḥ samādhirupadiṣṭo vedānteṣu- 'ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyasitavya so 'nveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ'
tathāca śāstram- 'yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati taditara itaraṃ paśyati'
ityavidyāvasthāyāṃ kartṛtvabhoktṛtve darśayitvā vidyāvasthāyāṃ te eva kartṛtvabhoktṛtve nivārayati- 'yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūttatkena kaṃ paśyet'

tathā svapnajāgaritayorātmana upādhisaṃparkakṛtaṃ śramaṃ śyenasyevākāśe viparipatataḥ śrāvayitvā tadabhāvaṃ suṣuptau prājñenātmanā saṃpariṣvaktasya śrāvayati- 'tadvā asyaitadāptakāmamātmakāmamakāmaṃ rūpaṃ śokāntaram
ityārabhya eṣāsya paramā gatireṣāsya paramā saṃpadeṣo 'sya paramo loka eṣo 'syaparama ānandaḥ
tathāca śrutirivākārānubaddhameva svapnavyāpāraṃ varṇayati- 'uteva strībhiḥ saha modamāno jakṣadutevāpi bhayāni paśyan'
tathānyatrāpi brahmaprakriyāyāmevāyamarthaḥ prapañcyate- 'tvaṃ strī tvaṃ pumānasi tvaṃ kumāra uta vā kumārī / tvaṃ jīrṇo daṇḍena vañcasi tvaṃ jāto bhavasi viśvatomukhaḥ'
iti caivamādiṣūtpattiprakaraṇeṣu prāṇānāmutpajirnāmnāyate kvaciccānutpattirevaiṣāmāmnāyate 'asadvā idamagra āsīt'
iti, 'sa prāṇamasṛjata prāṇācchraddhāṃ khaṃ vāyurjyotirāpaḥ pṛthivīndriyaṃ mano 'nnam'
atra prāṇotpattivādivākyajātamujadāharaṇam- 'etasmādātmanaḥ sarve prāṇāḥ sarve lokāḥ sarve devāḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni vyuccaranti'
tathāhi- asminneva prakaraṇe tejobannapūrvakatvaṃ vākprāṇamanasāmāmnāyate- 'annamayaṃ hi somya mana āpomayaḥ prāṇastejomayī vāk'
atha bhāktaṃ tatāpi brahmakartṛkāyāṃ nāmarūpavyākriyāyāṃ śravaṇāt 'yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati'
iti / kvaciccāṣṭau prāṇā grahatvena guṇena saṃkīrtyante- ' aṣṭau grahā aṣṭāvatigrahāḥ''
hastādayastvapare saptabhyo 'tiriktāḥ prāṇāḥ śrūyante- 'hastau vai grahaḥ sa karmaṇātigraheṇa gṛhīto hastābhyāṃ hi karma karoti'
tathā codāhṛtā śrutiḥ - 'daśeme puruṣe prāṇā ātmaikādaśaḥ'
tathāca śrutiḥ kāmādyā nānāvidhā vṛttiranukramyāha- 'etatsarvaṃ mana eva'
saptaiva prāṇāḥ syuryataḥ saptānāmeva gatiḥ śrūyate- 'tamutkrāmantaṃ prāṇo 'nūtkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anūtkrāmanti'
saptaiva hi prāṇāścakṣurādayastvakparyantā viśeṣitā iha prakṛtāḥ 'sa yatraiva cākṣuṣaḥ puruṣaḥ parāṅparyāvartate 'thārūpajño bhavati'
evaṃprāpte brūmaḥ - hastādayastvapare saptabhyo 'tiriktāḥ prāṇāḥ pratīyante-' hastau vai grahaḥ'

grahatvaṃ ca bandhanabhāvo gṛhyate,badhyate kṣetrajño 'nena grahasaṃjñakena bandhaneneti / sa ca kṣetrajño naikasminneva śarīre badhyate, śarīrāntareṣvi tulyatvādbandhanasya / tasmāccharīrāntarasaṃcārīdaṃ grahasaṃjñakaṃ bandanamityarthāduktaṃ bhavati / tathāca smṛtiḥ - puryaṣṭakena liṅgena prāṇādyena sa yujyate / tena baddhasya vai bandho mokṣo muktasya tena ca / iti prāṅmokṣādgrahasaṃjñakenānena bandhanenāviyogaṃ darśayati / ātharvaṇe ca viṣayendriyānukramaṇe cakṣuṣa draṣṭavyaṃ ca ityatra tulyavaddhastādīnīndriyāṇi saviṣayāṇyanukrāmati-' hastau cādātavyaṃ copasthaścānandayitavyaṃ ca pāyuśca visarjayitavyaṃ ca pādau ca gantavyaṃ ca'
tathā 'daśeme puruṣe prāṇā ātmaikādaśaste yadāsmāccharīrānmartyādutkrāmantyatha rodayanti'
śreṣṭha iti ca mukhyaṃ prāṇamabhidadhāti- 'prāṇo vāva jyeṣṭhaśca śreṣṭhaśca'
śreṣṭhaśca prāṇo guṇādhikyāt, 'na vai śakṣyāmastvadṛte jīvitum'
vāyostāvatprāṇasya pṛthagupadeśo bhavati- 'prāṇa eva brahmaṇaścaścaturthaḥ pādaḥ sa vāyunā jyotiṣā bhāti ca tapati ca'

tathāhi śrutiḥ prāṇāntareṣvasaṃbhāvyamānaṃ mukhyaprāṇasya vaiśeṣikaṃ kāryaṃ darśayati prāṇasaṃvādādiṣu- 'atha ha prāṇā ahaṃśreyasi vyūdire' ityupakramya 'yasminva utkrānte śarīraṃ pāpiṣṭhataramiva dṛśyate sa vaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ'
'tāvanvariṣṭhaḥ prāṇa uvāca mā mohamāpadyathāhamevaitatpañcadhātmānaṃ pravibhajyaitadbāṇamavaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmi, iti caitamevārthaṃ śrutirāha- 'prāṇena rakṣannavaraṃ kulāyam'
itaścāsti mukhyasya prāṇasya vaiśeṣikaṃ kāryaṃ, yatkāraṇaṃ pañcavṛttirayaṃ vyapadiśyate śrutiṣu 'prāṇo 'pāno vyāna udānaḥ samānaḥ'
nanu vibhutvamapi prāṇasya samāmnāyate- 'samaḥ pluṣiṇā samo maśakena samo nāgena sama ebhistribhirlokaiḥ samo 'nena sarveṇa
tathānyatrāpi vāgeva brahmaṇaścaturthaḥ pādaḥ so 'gninā jyotiṣā bhāti ca tapati ca'
'sa vai vācameva prathamāmatyavahatsā yadā mṛtyumatyamucyata so 'gnirabhavat'
śrutiśca bhavati- 'puṇyamevāmuṃ gacchati na ha vai devānpāpaṃ gacchati'
tathāhi śrutirmukhyamitarāṃśca prāṇānsaṃnidhāpya mukhyātmatāmitareṣāṃ khyāpayati- 'hantāsyaiva sarve rūpamasāmeti ta etasyaiva sarve rūpamabhavan'
bhedena vāgādibhyaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvatra śrūyate- 'te ha vācamūcuḥ'
iti śruteḥ prāṇa evendriyāṇīti, tadayuktam / tatrāpi paurvāparyālocanādbhedapratīteḥ / tathāhi- vadiṣyāmyevāhamiti vāgdadhre'
iti vāgādīnīndriyāṇyanukramya 'tāni mṛtyuḥ śramo bhūtvopayeme tasmācchrāmyatyeva vāk' iti ca śramarūpeṇa mṛtyunā grastatvaṃ vāgādīnāmabhidhāya 'athemameva nāpnodyo 'yaṃ madhyamaḥ prāṇaḥ'
tathāca śrutiḥ - 'ta etasyaiva sarve rūpamabhavan / tasmādeta etenākhyāyante prāṇāḥ'
satprakriyāyāṃ tejobannānāṃ sṛṣṭimabhidhāyopadiśyate- 'seyaṃ devataikṣata hantāhamimāstisro devatā anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇīti / tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikāṃ karavāṇīti'
tacca trivṛtkaraṇamagnyādityacandravidyutsu śrutirdarśayati- 'yadagre rohitaṃ rūpaṃ tejasastadrūpaṃ yacchuklaṃ tadapāṃ yatkṛṣṇaṃ tadannasya'
tāsāṃ tisṛṇāṃ devatānāṃ bahistrivṛtkṛtānāṃ satīnāmadhyātmamaparaṃ trivṛtkaraṇamuktam- 'imāstisro devatāḥ puruṣaṃ prāpya trivṛttrivṛdekaikā bhavati'
tathāhi śrutiḥ - 'annamaśitaṃ tredhā vidhīyate tasya yaḥ sthaviṣṭho dhātustatpurīṣaṃ bhavati yo madhyamastanmāṃsaṃ yo 'ṇiṣṭhastanmanaḥ'
tathāhi praś naḥ - 'vettha yathā pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacaso bhavanti'
nirūpaṇaṃ ca prativacanaṃ dyuparjanyapṛthivīpuruṣayoṣitsu pañcasvagniṣu śraddhāsomavṛṣṭyannaretorūpāḥ pañcāhutirdarśayitvā 'iti tu pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacaso bhavanti'
nanvanyā śrutirjalūkāvatpūrvadehaṃ na muñcati yāvanna dehāntaramākramatīti darśayati- 'tadyathā tṛṇajalāyukā'
prāṇānāṃ ca dehāntarapratipattau gatiḥ śrāvyate- 'tamutkrāmantaṃ prāṇo 'nūtkrāmati prāṇamanūtkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anūtkrāmanti'
tathāhi śrutirmaraṇakāle vāgādayaḥ prāṇā agnyādīndevāgacchatīti darśayati- 'yatrāsya puruṣasya mṛtasyāgniṃ vāgapyeti vātaṃ prāṇaḥ'
teṣāṃ ca pramukhe 'asau vāva loko gautamāgniḥ'
'atha ya ime grāma iṣṭāpūrte dattamityupāsate te dhūmamabhisaṃbhavanti'
ityupakramyeṣṭādikāriṇāṃ dhūmādinā pitṛyāṇena pathā candraprāptiṃ kathayati- 'ākāśāccandramasameṣa somo rājā'
ta evehāpi pratīyante 'tasminnetasminnagnau devāḥ śraddhāṃ juhvati tasyā āhuteḥ somo rājā saṃbhavati'
tatastāḥ śraddhāpūrvakakarmasamavāyinya āhutimayya āpo 'pūrvarūpāḥ satyastāniṣṭādikāriṇo jīvānpariveṣṭayāmuṃ lokaṃ phaladānāya nayantīti yattadatra juhotinābhidhīyate- 'śraddhāṃ juhvati'
yāvatā teṣāṃ dhūmapratīkena vartmanā candramasamadhirūḍhānāmannabhāvaṃ darśayati- 'eṣa somo rājā taddevānāmannaṃ te devā bhakṣayanti'
iti 'te candraṃ prāpyānnaṃ bhavanti tāṃstatra devā yathā somaṃ rājānamapyāyasvāpakṣīyasvetyevamenāṃstatra bhakṣayanti'
'na ha vai devā aśnanti na pibantyetadevāmṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā tṛpyanti'
tathāhi śrutiranātmavidāṃ devopabhogyatāṃ darśayati- 'atha yo 'nyāṃ devatāmupāste 'nyo 'sāvanyo 'hamasmīti na sa veda yathā paśurevaṃ sa devānām'
tathāhi śrutyantaraṃ candramaṇḍale bhogasadbhāvaṃ darśayati- 'sa somaloke vibhūtimanubhūya punarāvartate'
tathānyadapi śrutyantaram 'atha ye śataṃ pitṛṇāṃ jitalolokānāmānandāḥ sa ekaḥ karmadevanāmānando ye karmaṇā devatvamabhisaṃpadyate'
iṣṭādikāriṇāṃ dhūmādinā vartmanā candramaṇḍalamadhirūḍhānāṃ bhuktabhogānāṃ tataḥ pratyavaroha āmnāyate- 'tasminyāvatsaṃpātamuṣitvāthaitamevādhvāṃ punarnivartante tathetam'

tatredaṃ vicāryate- kiṃ niranuśayā bhuktakṛtsnakarmāṇo 'varohantyāhosvitsānuśayā iti / kiṃ tāvatprāptam / niranuśayā iti / kutaḥ - yāvatsaṃpātamiti viśeṣaṇāt / saṃpātaśabdenātra karmāśaya ucyate- saṃpatantyanenāsmāllokādamuṃ lokaṃ phalopabhogāyeti / yāvatsaṃpātamuṣitveti ca kṛtsnasya tasya kṛtasya tatraiva bhuktatāṃ darśayati / teṣāṃ yadā tatparyaveti'

tathāhi pratyakṣā śrutiḥ sānuśayānāmavarohaṃ darśayati- 'tadya iha ramaṇīyacaraṇā abhyāśo ha yatte ramaṇīyāṃ yonimāpadyeranbrāhmaṇayoniṃ vā kṣatriyayoniṃ vā vaiśyayoniṃ vātha yaiha ka pūyacaraṇāṃ abhyāśo ha yatte kapūyāṃ yonimāpadyerañśvayoniṃ vā sūkarayoniṃ vā caṇḍālayoniṃ vā'
śrutiśca karmācaraṇe bhedena vyapadiśati- 'yathākārī yathācārī tathā bhavati'

tathāhi yamavacanasarūpā śrutiḥ prayatāmaniṣṭādikāriṇāṃ yamavaśyatāṃ darśayati- 'na sāṃparāyaḥ pratibhāti bālaṃ pramādyantaṃ vittamohena mūḍham / ayaṃ loko nāsti para iti mānī punaḥ punarvaśamāpadyate me'
ityasya praśnasya prativacanāvasare śrūyate- 'athaitayoḥ pathorna katareṇacana tānīmāni kṣudrāṇyasakṛdāvartīni bhūtāni bhavanti / jāyasva mriyasvetyetattṛtīyaṃ sthānaṃ tenāsau loko na saṃpūryate'
śrutistu tṛtīyasthānasaṃkīrtanenāsaṃpūraṇaṃ darśayati- 'etattṛtīyaṃ sthānaṃ tenāsau loko na saṃpūryate'
tathāhyantareṇaivāhutisaṃkhyāniyamaṃ varṇitena prakāreṇa tṛtīyasthānaprāptirupalabhyate 'jāyasva mriyasvetyetattṛtīyaṃ sthānam'
nanu 'teṣāṃ khalveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ trīṇyeva bījāni bhavanti aṇḍajaṃ jīvajamudbhijjam'
tatreyamavarohaśrutirbhavati- 'athaicamevādhvānaṃ punarnivartante yathetamākāśamākāśādvāyuṃ vāyirbhūtvā dhūmo bhavati dhūmo bhūtvābhraṃ bhavatyabhraṃ bhūtvā megho bhūtvā pravarṣati'
tathāhi vrīhyādibhāvāpatteranantaraṃ viśinaṣṭi- 'ato vai khalu durniṣprapataram'
tasminnevārohe pravarṣaṇānantaraṃ paṭhyate- 'ta iha vrīhiyavā oṣadhivanaspatayastilamāṣā iti jāyante'
itaśca vrīhyādisaṃśleṣamātraṃ tadbhāvo yatkāraṇaṃ vrīhyādibhāvasyānantaramanuśayināṃ retaḥsigbhāva āmnāyate - 'yo yo hyannamatti yo retaḥ siñcati tadbhūya eva bhavati'
ityupakramya 'na tatra rathā na rathayogā na panthāno bhavantyatha rathānrathayogānpathaḥ sṛjate'
saṃdhyamiti svapnānamācaṣṭe, vede prayogadarśanāt 'saṃdhyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ svapnasthānam'
apicaike śākhino 'sminneva saṃdhye sthāne kāmānāṃ nirmātāramātmānamāmananti- 'ya eṣa supteṣu jāgarti kāmaṃ kāmaṃ puruṣo nirmimāṇaḥ'
ityādi, tadviṣaya eva ca vākyaśeṣo 'pi- 'tadeva śukraṃ tadbrahma tadevāmṛtamucyate / tasmiṃllokāḥ śritāḥ sarve tadu nātyeti kaścana''
tathāca śrutiḥ - atho khalvāhurjāgaritadeśa evāsyaiṣa iti yāni hyeva jāgratpaśyati tāni suptaḥ
darśayati ca śrutirantareva dehe svapnam- 'sa yatraitatsvapnyayā carati' ityupakramya 'sve śarīre yathākāmaṃ parivartate'

ratho 'yamiti hi kadācitsvapne nirdhāritaḥ kṣaṇena manuṣyaḥ saṃpadyate manuṣyo 'yamiti nirdhāritaḥ kṣaṇena vṛkṣaḥ / spaṣṭaṃ cābhāvaṃ rathādīnāṃ svapne śrāvayati śāstram - ''na tatra rathā na rathayogā na panthāno bhavanti'
śrutyantare 'svayaṃ vihatya svayaṃ nirmāya svena bhāsā jyotiṣā prasvapiti'
tasya tu vākyaśeṣeṇa tadeva śukraṃ tadbrahmeti jīvabhāvaṃ vyāvartya brahmabhāva upadiśyate - 'tattvamasi'
tathāca śrutiḥ - 'jñātvā devaṃ sarvapāśāpahāniḥ kṣīṇaiḥ kleśairjanmamṛtyuprahāṇiḥ / tasyābhidhyānāttṛtīyaṃ dehabhede viśvaiśvaryaṃ kevala āptakāmaḥ'
kvacicchrūyate- 'tadyatraitatsuptaḥ samastaḥ svapnaṃ na vijānātyāsu tadā nāḍīṣu sṛpo bhavati'
anyatra tu nāḍīrevānukramya śrūyate - 'tābhiḥ pratyavasṛpya purītati śete'
tathānyatra 'satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati svamapīto bhavati'
'prājñenātmanā saṃpariśvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntaram'
nāḍyādīnāṃ tvekārthatā suṣuptau dṛśyate - 'nāḍīśu sṛpto bhavati'
nanu naivaṃ sati saptamīnirdeśo dṛśyate - 'satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati'
vākyaśeṣo hi tatrāyatanaiṣī jīvaḥ sadupasarpatītyāha - 'anyatrāyatanamalabdhvā prāṇamevopaśrayate'
saptamīnirdeśo 'pi tatra vākyaśeṣe dṛśyate - 'sati saṃpadya na viduḥ sati saṃpadyāmahe'
yatrāpi nirapekṣā iva nāḍīḥ suptisthānatvena śrāvayati - 'āsu tadā nāḍīṣu sṛpto bhavati'

iti bruvannāḍīḥ praśaṃsati / bravīti ca pāpmasparśābhāve hetum - tejasā nāḍīgatena pittākhyenābhivyāptakaraṇo na bāhyānviṣayānīkṣata ityarthaḥ / athavā tejaseti brahmaṇa evāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ / śrutyantare -' brahmaiva teja eva'
brahmasamapattiśca pāpmasparśābhāve hetuḥ samadhigataḥ - 'sarve pāpmāno 'ta nivartante 'pahatapāpmā hyeṣa brahmalokaḥ'
tathā purītato 'pi brahmaprakriyāyāṃ saṃkīrtanāttadanuguṇameva suptisthānatvaṃ vijñāyate - 'ya eṣo 'ntarhṛdaya ākāśastasmiñchete'
iti hṛdayākāśe suptisthāne prakṛta idamucyate 'purītati śete'
yata āha - 'satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati svamapīto bhavati'
nāḍīṣu puratīti ca śayānasya na kiñcidavijñāne kāraṇaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātuṃ, bhedaviṣayatvāt 'yatra vā anyadiva syāttatrānyo 'nyatpaśyet'
yasmāccātmaiva suptisthānamata eva ca kāraṇānnityavadevāsmādātmanaḥ prabodhaḥ svāpādhikāre śiṣyate - 'kuta etadāgāt'
ityasya praśnasya prativacanāvasare 'yathāgneḥ kṣudrā visphuliṅgā vyuccārantyevamevaitasmādātmanaḥ sarve prāṇāḥ'
'sarvāḥ prajā aharahargacchantya etaṃ brahmalokaṃ na vindanti'
'ta iha vyāghro vā siṃho vā vṛko vā varāho vā kīṭo vā pataṅgo vā daṃśo vā maśako vā yadyadbhavanti tadābhavanti'
yāvatā suptaṃ prati tāvaduktaṃ śrutyā - 'satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati'
'naitaṃ setumahorātre tarato na jarā na mṛtyurna śoko na sukṛtaṃ na dṛṣkṛtam'
santyubhayaliṅgāḥ śrutayo brahmaviṣayāḥ 'sarvakarmā sarvakāmaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvarasaḥ'
pratyupādhibhedaṃ hyabhedameva brahmaṇaḥ śrāvayati śāstram - 'yaścāyamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ tejomayo 'mṛtamayaḥ puruṣo yaścāyamadhyātmaṃ śārīrastejomayo 'mṛtamayaḥ puruṣo 'yameva sa yo 'yamātmā'
apicaivaṃ bhedadarsananindāpūrvakamabhedadarśanamevaike śākhinaḥ samāmananti - 'manasaivedamāptavyaṃ neha nānāsti kiñcana / mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyupamāpnoti ya iha nāneva paśyati'
tathānyepi 'bhoktā bhogyaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā sarvaṃ trividhaṃ brahma me tat'
rūpādyākārarahitameva brahmāvadhārayitavyaṃ na rūpādimat / kasmāt / tatpradhānatvāt / ''asthūlamanaṇvarhrasvamadīrdham'
mukti. 2.72) 'ākāśo vai nāma nāmarūpayornirvahitā te yadantarā tadbrahma'
āha ca śrutiścaitanyamātraṃ vilakṣaṇarūpāntararahitaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ brahma - 'sa yathā saindhavaghano 'ntaro 'bāhyaḥ kṛtsno rasaghana evaivaṃ vā are 'yamātmānantaro 'bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñānaghana eva'
darśayati ca śrutiḥ pararūpapratiṣedhenaiva brahma nirviśeṣatvāt- 'athāta ādeśo neti neti'
darśayati ca śrutiḥ parasyaiva brahmaṇo dehādiṣūpādhiṣvantaranupraveśam - 'puruścakre dvipadaḥ puruścakre catuśpadaḥ / puraḥ sa pakṣī bhūtvā puraḥ puruṣa āviśat'
ye hi paravidyādhikāre kecitprapañcā ucyante yathā - 'yuktā hyasya harayaḥ śatā deśetyaya vai harayo 'yaṃ vai sahasrāṇi bahūni cānantāni ca'
ye punarupāsanādhikāre prapañcā ucyante yathā 'manomayaḥ prāṇasīro bhārūpaḥ'
tato brahmaivāvidyādhyastaprapañcapratyākhyānenāvedayitavyam ekamevādvitīyaṃ brahma, tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tatvamasi
'dve vāva brahmaṇo rūpe mūrtaṃ caivāmūrtaṃ ca'
ityupakramya pañcamahābhūtāni dvairāśyena pravibhajyāmabartarasasya ca puruṣaśabdoditasya mahārajanādīni rūpāṇi darśayitvā punaḥ paṭhyate - 'athāta ādeśo neti neti nahyetasmāditi netyanyatparamasti'

ubhayapratiṣedhe tu ko 'nyo bhāvaḥ pariśeṣyāt / apariśiṣyamāṇe cānyasminya itaraḥ pratiṣeddhumārabhyate pratiṣeddhumaśakyatvāttasyaiva paramārthatvāpatteḥ pratiṣedhānupapattiḥ / nāpi brahmapratiṣedha upapadyate ''brahma te bravāṇi'
prapañcite ca tadīye rūpadvaye rūpavataḥ svarūpajijñāsāyāmidamupakrāntam 'athāta ādeśo neti neti''
atha nāmadheyam - 'satyasya satyamiti prāṇa vai satyaṃ teṣāmeṣa satyam'
tathāhi śrutiḥ - 'parāñci khāni vyatṛṇatsvayaṃ bhūtasmātparāṅpaśyati nāntarātman / kaściddhīraḥ pratyagātmānamaikṣadāvṛttacakṣuramṛtatvamicchan'
yatkāraṇaṃ parasmādātmano 'nyaṃ cetanaṃ pratiṣedhati śāstram - 'nānyo 'to 'sti draṣṭā'
tathā saṃbandhavyapadeśo 'pi bhavati - 'satā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati'
tathāhi - 'atha ya eṣo 'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣo dṛśyate'
ityādityādhāramīśvaraṃ vyapadiśyatato bhedenākṣyādhāramīśvaraṃ vyapadiśati - 'atha ya eṣo 'ntikṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyate'
atideśaṃ cāsyāmunā rūpādiṣu karoti - 'tasyaitasya tadeva rūpaṃ yadamuṣya rūpaṃ yāvamuṣya geṣṇau yannāma tannāma'
sāvadhikaṃ ceśvaratvamubhayorvyapadiśati - 'ye cāmuṣmātparāñco lokāsteṣāṃ ceṣṭe devakāmānāṃ ca'
'naca brahmavyatiriktaṃ kiñcidajaṃ saṃbhavati sadeva somyedamagra āsīdekamevādvitīyam'
upapadyate cātredṛśa eva saṃbandho nānyādṛśaḥ 'svamapīto bhavati'
tathāca śrutirekasyāpyākāśasya stānakṛtaṃ bhedavyapadeśamupapādayati - 'yo 'yaṃ bahirdhā puruṣādākāśaḥ'
tathāca śrutirbhavati - 'sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmānnādo vasudānaḥ'
chandogāstu taṃ nāmananti pañcasaṃkhyayaiva ca ta upasaṃharanti 'atha ha ya etānevaṃ pañcāgnīnveda'
vājasaneyinastu pañcamamapyāmananti 'reto vai prajāpatiḥ prajāyate ha prajayā paśubhirya evaṃ veda'
paṭhyate 'pi ca ṣaṣṭho 'gniśchandogaiḥ - 'taṃ pretaṃ diṣṭamito 'gnaya evaṃ haranti'
vājasaneyinastu sāṃpādikeṣu pañcasvagniṣvanuvṛttāyāḥ samiddhūmādikalpanāyā nivṛttaye 'tasyāgnirevāgnirbhavati samitsamit'
darśayati ca vedo 'pi vidyaikatvaṃ sarvavedānteṣu vedyaikatvopadeśāt sarve vedā yatparamāmananti
tathā vājasaneyake prādeśamātrasaṃpāditasya vaiśvānarasya chāndogye siddhavadupādānam 'yastvetamevaṃ prādeśamātramabhivimānamātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramupāste'
iti prakramya vāgādīnprāṇānasurapāpmaviddhatvena ninditvā mukhyaprāṇaparigrahaḥ paṭhyate - 'atha hemamāsanyaṃ prāṇamūcustvaṃ na udgāyeti tatheti tebhya eṣa prāṇa udagāyat'
iti prakramyetarānprāṇānasurapāpmaviddhatvena ninditvā tathaiva mukhyaprāṇaparigrahaḥ paṭhyate - 'atha ha ya evāyaṃ mukhyaḥ prāṇastamudgīthamupāsāṃcakrire'
anyathā hi prakramante vājasaneyino 'nyathā chandogāḥ 'tvaṃ na udgāya'
vājasaneyake 'picodgīthasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ prāṇasya śrutam - 'eṣa u vā udgīthaḥ'
ityevamudgīthāvayavasyoṅkārasyopāsyatvaṃ prastutya rasatamādiguṇopavyākhyānaṃ tatra kṛtvā atha khalvetasyaivākṣarasyopavyākhyānaṃ bhavati
iti punarapi tamevodgīthāvayavamoṅkāramanuvartya devāsurākhyāyikādvāreṇa tam prāṇamudgīthamupāsāṃcakrire
tathāca tatraiva śrāvitam- vācā ca hyeva sa prāṇena codagāyat
śrūyata eva phalam 'āpayitā ha vai kāmānāṃ bhavati'
vāgādayo 'pi hi tatra vasiṣṭhatvādiguṇānvitā uktāḥ te ca prāṇe punaḥ pratyarpitāḥ - 'yadvā ahaṃ vasiṣṭho 'smi tvaṃ tadvasiśṣo 'si'
tathāhi - taittirīyaka ānandamayamātmānaṃ prakramyāmnāyate - 'tasya priyameva śiraḥ / modo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ / pramoda uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ / ānanda ātmā / brahma pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā'
kāṭhake hi paṭhyate - 'indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaśca paraṃ manaḥ / manasastu parā buddhiḥ'
ityārabhya 'puruṣānna paraṃ kiñcitsā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ'
yatkāraṇam 'eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhotmā na prakāśate / dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ'
yathā cetarasmiṃllaukikātmaśabdaprayoge pratyagātmaiva mukhya ātmaśabdena gṛhyate tathehāpi bhavitumarhati yatra tu 'ātmaivedamagra āsīt'
vājasaneyake 'katama ātmeti yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu hṛdyantarjyotiḥ puruṣaḥ'
tathāhyupasaṃharati - 'sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmājaro 'maro 'mṛto 'bhayo brahma'
tathā prāgutpatterekatvāvadhāraṇaṃ jīvasya cātmaśabdena parāmarśaḥ svāpāvasthāyāṃ ca tatsvabhāvasaṃpattikathanaṃ paricodanāpūrvakaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ 'tattvamasi'
anantaraṃ ca chandogā āmananti -'tasmādvā etadaśiṣyantaḥ purastāccoṣṭāccādbhiḥ paridadhāti'
vājasaneyinastvāmananti - 'tadvidvāṃsaḥ śrotriyā aśiṣyanta ācāmantyaśitvācāmantyetameva tadanamanagnaṃ kurvanto manyante'
tasmātprāptamevāśisiṣatāmaśitavatāṃ cobhayata ācamanamanūdya 'etameva tadanamanagnaṃ kurvanto manyante'
apica 'yadidaṃ kiñcāśvasya ā kṛmibhya ā kīṭapataṅgebhyastatte 'nnam

tatra ca guṇāḥ śrūyante - sa ātmānamupāsīta manamayaṃ prāṇaśarīraṃ bhārūpam ityevamādayaḥ. tasyāmeva śāstrāyāṃ bṛhadāraṇyake punaḥ paṭhyate - 'manomayo 'yaṃ puruṣo bhāḥ satyasminnantarhadaye yadā vrīhirvā yavo vā sa eṣa sarvasyeśānaḥ sarvasyādhipatiḥ sarvamidaṃ praśāsti yadidaṃ kiñca'
kathaṃ sthānaviśeṣopanibandha ityucyate - 'ya eṣa etasminmaṇḍale puruṣaḥ'
api caivañjātīyakānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ vyavastheti liṅgadarśanaṃ bhavati - 'tasyaitasya tadeva rūpaṃ yāvamuṣya geṣṇau tau geṣṇau yannāma tannāma'
tathāhi śāṇḍilyavidyāyāṃ hṛdayāyatanatvaṃ brahmaṇa uktam - 'eṣa ma ātmāntarhṛdaye'
'eṣa u eva bhāmanīreṣa hi sarveṣu lokeṣu bhāti'
'yāvānvā ayamākāśastāvāneṣo 'ntarhṛdaya ākāśa ubhe asmindyāvāpṛthivī antareva samāhite'
āyurabhivṛddhiphalo hyasau 'sa ha --ṣoḍaśaṃ varṣaśataṃ jīvati ya evaṃ veda'
asti tāṇḍānāṃ śrutiḥ - 'aśva iva romāṇi vidhūya pāpaṃ candra iva rāhormukhātpramucya dhūtvā śarīramakṛtaṃ kṛtātmā brahmalokamabhisaṃbhavāmi'
aśvaśca romāṇi vidhūnvānastyajanrajaḥ sahaiva tena romāṇyapi jīrṇāni śātayati 'aśva iva romāṇi vidhūya pāpam'
tathā hyanye 'pi śikhinastāṇḍinaḥ śāṭyāyaninaśca prāgavasthāyāmeva sukṛtaduṣkṛtahānamāmananti 'aśva iva romāṇi vidhūya pāpam'
iti pañcāgnividyāvatāṃ devayānaṃ panthānamavatārayantī 'ye ceme 'raṇye śraddhātapa ityupāsate'
vājasaneyinastu pañcāgnividyādhikāre 'dhīyate - 'ya evametadvidurye cāmī araṇye śraddhāṃ satyamupāsate'
'atha ya etau panthānau na viduste pataṅgā yadidaṃ dandaśūkam'
samṛtirapi - 'śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate / ekayā yātyānāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ'
yathāsau bhagavānsavitā sahsrayugaparyantaṃ jagato 'dhikāraṃ caritvā tadavasāna udayāstamayavarjitaṃ kaivalyamanubhavati 'atha tata ūrdhvaṃ udetya naivodetā nāstametaikala eva madhye sthātā'
smṛtirapi - 'yathaidhāṃsi samiddho 'gnirbhasmasātkuruter'juna / jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā'
tathāca śrutiraviśeṣeṇaiva sarveṣāṃ jñānānmokṣaṃ darśayati 'tadyo yo devānāṃ pratyabudhyata sa eva tadabhavattatharṣīṇāṃ tathā manuṣyāṇām'
tathā kaṭhāḥ 'ṛtaṃ pibantau sukṛtasya loke guhāṃ praviṣṭau parame parārdhe / chāyātapau brahmavido vadanti pañcāgnayo ye ca triṇāciketāḥ'
tadviṣaya eva cātrāpi vākyaśeṣo bhavati 'yaḥ seturījānānāmakṣaraṃ brahma yatparam'
yathā 'eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā'
yathā tāṇḍināmupaniṣadi ṣaṣṭhe prapāṭhake - 'sa ātmā tattvamasi śvekateto'
'sa yo haitaṃ mahadyakṣaṃ prathamajaṃ veda brahma'
ityādinā vājasaneyake satyavidyāṃ sanāmākṣaropāsanāṃ vidhāyānantimāmnāyate - 'tadyattatsatyamaso sa ādityo ya eṣa etasminmaṇḍale puruṣo yaścāyaṃ dakṣiṇe 'kṣanpuruṣaḥ'
kecitpunarasminsūtra idaṃ ca vājasaneyakamakṣyādityapuruṣaviṣayaṃ vākyaṃ, chāndogye ca - 'atha ya eṣo 'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣo dṛśyate'
chāndogye hi jyotiṣṭomakarmasamabandhinīyamudgīthavyapāśrayā vidyā vijñāyate tatra hyadimadhyāvasāneṣu hi karmasaṃbandhacihnāni bhavanti 'iyamevargagniḥ sāma'
atha yadidamasminbrahmapure daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ veśma daharo 'sminnantarākāśaḥ
iti prastutya chandogā adhīyate 'eṣa ātmāpahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyurviśoko vijighatso 'pipāsaḥ satyakāmaḥ satyasaṃkalpaḥ'
tathā vājasaneyinaḥ - sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmā yo 'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ prāṇeṣu ya eṣo 'ntarhadaya ākāśastasmiñchete sarvasya vaśī
yadetaccāndogye hṛdayākāśasya satyakāmatvādiguṇajātamulabhyate taditaratra vājasaneyake vaśitvādyupalabhyate tadapītaratra chāndogye eṣa ātmāpahatapāpmā
saguṇā hi brahmavidyā chāndogya upadiśyate 'atha ya ihātmānamanuvidya vrajantyetāṃśca satyānkāmān'
vājasaneyake tu nirguṇameva paraṃ brahmopadiśyamānaṃ dṛśyate 'ata ūrdhvaṃ vimokṣāya brūhi'
chāndogye vaiśvānaravidyāṃ prakṛtya śrūyate - 'tadyadbhaktaṃ prathamamāgacchettaddhomīyaṃ sa yāṃ prathamāmāhutiṃ juhuyāttāṃ juhuyātprāṇasya svāhā'
tāsu ca parastādagnihotraśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ 'ya etadevaṃ vidvānagnihotraṃ juhoti'
iti 'yatheha kṣudhitā bālā mātaraṃ paryupāsate / evaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyagnihotramupāsate'
ata eva cehāpi sāṃpādikānyevāgnihotrāṅgāni darśayati - 'ura eva vedirlomāni bahurhṛdayaṃ gārhapatyo mano 'nvāhāryapacana āsyamāhavanīyaḥ'
yattveṣāṃ svavākyeṣu phalaśravaṇam 'āpayitā ha vaikāmānāṃ bhavati'
prastāvādidevatāvijñānavihīnānāmapi prastotrādīnāṃ yājanādhyavasānadarsanāt 'prastotaryā devatā prastāvamanvāyattā tāṃ cedavidvānprastoṣyasi'

api caivañjātīyakasya karmavyapāśrayasya vijñānasya pṛthageva karmaṇaḥ phalamupalabhyate karmaphalasiddhiddyapratibandhastatsamṛddhiratiśayaviśeṣaḥ kaścit 'tenobhau kuruto yaścaitadevaṃ veda yaśca na veda / nānā tu vidyā cāvidyā ca yadeva vidyayā karoti śraddhayopaniṣadā tadeva vīryavattaraṃ bhavati'
tathā lokasāmādiṣu pratiniyatāni pratyupāsanaṃ phalāni śiṣyante 'kalpante hāsmai lokā ūrdhvāścāvṛttāśca'
ityatrādhyātmaṃ vāgādīnāṃ śreṣṭho 'vadhārito 'dhidaivatamagnyādīnāṃ vāyuḥ tathā chāndogye - 'vāyurvāva saṃvargaḥ'
tathā 'ta ete sarva eva samāḥ sarvo 'nantāḥ'
iti prāṇenaivopasaṃharannetvaṃ darśayati / tasmādekameva vrataṃ caretprāṇyāccaivāpāyānyācca'
tathā chāndogye 'pi parastāt 'mahātmanaścaturo deva ekaḥ kaḥ sa jāgara bhuvanasya gopāḥ'
'sa yathaiṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ madhyamaḥ prāṇa evametāsāṃ devatānāṃ vāyuḥ'
bhagnavratāni hi vāgādīnyuktāni 'tāni mṛtyuḥ śramo bhūtvopayeme'
iti cektvā 'teno etasyai devatāyai sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ jayati
tathā 'tau vā etau dvau saṃvargau vāyureva deveṣu prāṇaḥ prāṇeṣu'
iti bhedena vyapadiśati 'te vā ete pañcānye pañcānye daśa santastatkṛtam'
yathā 'sa vā eṣa eva mṛtyurya eṣa etasminmaṇḍale puruṣaḥ' iti 'agnirvai mṛtyuḥ'
yathā ca 'asau vāva loko gautamāgnistasyāditya eva samit'
samāptā prāsaṅgikī kathā, saṃprati tu prakṛtāmevānuvartāmahe - 'omtyetadakṣaramudgīthamupāsīta'
vyastopāsanaṃ tāvat 'aupamanyava kaṃ tvamātmānamupāḥsa iti devameva bhagavo rājanniti hovācaiṣa vai sutejā ātmā vaiśvānaro yaṃ tvamātmānamupāḥse'
tathā samastopāsanamapi 'tasya ha vā etasyātmano vaiśvānarasyamūrdhaiva sutejāścakṣurviśvarūpa prāṇaḥ pṛthagvartmātmā saṃdeho bahulo bastireva rayiḥ pṛthivyeva pādau'
pratyavayavaṃ sutejaḥprabhṛtiṣūpāḥsa iti kriyāpadaśravaṇāt 'tasmāttava sutaṃ prasutamāsutaṃ kule dṛśyate'

tathāhi - prācīnaśālaprabhṛtaya uddālakāvasānāḥ ṣaḍṛṣayo vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ pariniṣṭhamapratipadyamānā aśvapatiṃ kaikeyaṃ rājānamabhyājagmurityupakramyaikaikasyarṣerupāsyaṃ dyuprabhṛtīnāmekaikaṃ śrāvayitvā 'mūrdhā tveṣa ātmana iti hovāca'
punaśca vyastopāsanaṃ vyāvartya samastopāsanamevānuvartya 'sa sarveṣu lokeṣu sarveṣu bhūteṣu sarveṣvātmasvannamatti'
ityevamādiṣu / tathā eka eva prāṇaḥ prāṇo vāva saṃvargaḥ'
yāsu punaḥ kāmyāsu vidyāsu 'sa ya etamevaṃ vāyuṃ diśāṃ vatsaṃ veda na putrarodaṃ roditi'
'sa yo nāma brahmetyupāste yāvannāmno gataṃ tatrāsya yatākāmacāro bhavati'
vidyāyāṃ ca vidyāśrayaṃ santamoṅkāraṃ vetrayasādhāraṇāṃśrāvayati- 'teneyaṃ trayī vidyā vartata omityāśrāyatyomiti śaṃsatyomityudgāyati'
darśayati ca śrutisahabhāvaṃ pratyayānam - 'evaṃviddha vai brahmā yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ sarvāṃścartvijo 'bhirakṣati'
'yadeva vidyayā karoti śraddhayopaniṣadā tadeva vīryavattaraṃ bhavati'
'ācāryakulādvedamadhītya yathāvidānaṃ guroḥ karmātiśeṣeṇābhisamāvṛttya kuṭumbe śucau deśe svādhyāyamadhīyānaḥ'
evaṃ tvayi nānyatheto 'sti na karma lipyate nare'
yattu priyādisaṃsūcitasya saṃsāriṇa evātmano vedyatayānukarṣaṇam 'ātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavati / ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ'
'yaḥ prāṇena prāṇiti sa ta ātmā sarvāntaraḥ'
iti caivamādi tadapi 'asya mahato bhūtasya niḥśvasitametadyadṛgvedaḥ'
etaddha sma vai tatpūrve vidvāṃso 'gnihotraṃ na juhavāñcakrire' 'etaṃ vai tamātmānaṃ viditvā brāhmaṇāḥ putraiṣaṇāyāśca vittaiṣaṇayāśca lokaiṣaṇāyāśca vyutthāyātha bhikṣācaryaṃ caranti'
yājñavalkyādīnāmapi brahmavidāmarmaniṣṭhatvaṃ dṛśyate - 'etāvadare khalvamṛtatvamiti hoktvā yājñavalkyo vijahāra'
kāmakāreṇeti śrutirbhavati vājasaneyinām 'etaddha sma vai tatpūrve vidvāṃsaḥ prajāṃ na kāmayante kiṃ prajayā kariṣyāmo yeṣāṃ no 'yamātmāyaṃ lokaḥ'
apica karmākārahetoḥ kriyākārakaphalalakṣaṇasya samastasya prapañcasyāvidyākṛtasya vidyāsāmarthyātsvarūpopamardamāmananti - 'yatra vā asya sarvamātmatmaivābhūttatkena kaṃ paśyettatkena kaṃ jighret'

trayo dharmaskandhā ityatra tāvadyajño 'dhyayanaṃ dānamiti prathamastapa eva dvitīyo brahmacāryācāryakulavāsī tṛtīyo 'tyantamātmānamācāryakule 'vasādayansarva ete puṇyalokā bhavantīti parāmarśapūrvakamāśramāṇāmanātyantikaphalatvaṃ saṃkīrtyātyantikaphalatayā brahmasaṃsthatā stūyate - 'brahmasaṃstho 'mṛtatvameti'
ityevamādiṣu / tathā etameva pravrājino lokamicchantaḥ pravrajanti'
'sa eṣa rasānāṃ rasatamaḥ paramaḥ parārdhyo 'ṣṭamo yadudgīthaḥ'
pratiprakaraṇaṃ ca phalāni śrāvyate - 'āpayitā ha vai kāmānāṃ bhavati'
'atha ha yājñavalkyasya dve bhārye babhūvaturmaitreyī ca kātyayanī ca'
tathāhi śrutiḥ - 'tametaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasānāśakena'
'sarve vedā yatpadamāmananti tapāṃsi sarvāṇi ca yadvadanti / yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa bravīmi'
itthaṃ mahābhāgā vidyā syādvidyārthī 'tasmādevaṃvicchanto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ samāhito bhūtvātmaneyevātmānaṃ paśyati'
prāṇasaṃvāde śrūyate chandogānām - 'na ha vā evaṃvidi kiñcanānannaṃ bhavati'
tathā vājasaneyinām - 'na ha vā asyānnaṃ jagdhaṃ bhavati nānannaṃ pratigṛhītam'
nahyatra vidhāyakaḥ śabda upalabhyate 'na ha vā evaṃvidi kiñcanānannaṃ bhavati'
tathāhi śrutiścākrāyaṇasyerṣeḥ kaṣṭāyāmavasthāyāmabhakṣyabhakṣaṇe pravṛttiṃ darśayati - 'maṭacīhateṣu kuruṣu'
vidyāsahakārīṇi caitāni syurvihitatvādeva 'tametaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti'
sahakāritvasyaivaitadupodbalakaṃ liṅgadarsanamanabhibhavaṃ ta darśayati śrutirbrahmacaryādisādhanasaṃpannasya rāgadibhiḥ kleśaiḥ 'eṣa hyātmā na naśyati yaṃ brahmacaryeṇānuvindate'
phalaṃ hi śrūyate - 'varṣati hāsmai varṣayati ha ya etadevaṃ vidvānvṛṣṭau pañcavidhaṃ sāmopāste'
nanvṛtvijo 'pi phalaṃ dṛṣṭam 'ātmane vā yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tamāgāyati'
tathāca 'taṃ ha bako dālbhyo vidāñcakāra sa ha naimiśīyānāmudgātā babhūva
'tasmādbrahmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ nirvidya bālyena tiṣṭhāsedbālyaṃ ca pāṇḍityaṃ ca nirvidyātha muniramaunaṃ ca monaṃ ca nirvidyātha brāhmaṇaḥ'
evaṃ bālyādiviśiṣṭe kaivalyāśrame śrutimati vidyamāne kasmācchāndogye gṛhiṇopasaṃhāraḥ 'abhisamāvṛtya kuṭumbe'
darśitā hi purastācchrutiḥ- 'tapaḥ eva dvitīyo brahmacaryācāryakulavāsī tṛtīyaḥ'
āścaryo 'sya vaktā kuśalo 'sya labdhāścaryo jñātā kuśalānuśiṣṭaḥ'
samṛtāvapi - 'aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati'
ityarjunena pṛṣṭo bhagavānvāsudevaḥ 'nahi kalyāṇakṛtkaściddurgatiṃ tāta gacchati'
ityuktvā punastasya puṇyalokaprāptiṃ sādhukule saṃbūtiṃ cābhidhāyānantaram 'tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam'
'ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ'
kvacit vidinā upakramya upāsina upasaṃharati yathā - 'yastadveda yatsa veda sa mayaitaduktaḥ'
iti atra 'anu ma etāṃ bhagavo devatāṃ śādhi yāṃ devatāmupāḥse'
kvacit ca upāsina upakramya vidinā upasaṃharati yathā - 'mano brahmetyupāsīta'
iti atra 'bhāti ca tapati ca kīrtyā yaśasā brahmavarcasena ya evaṃ veda'
caitanyasya tu suṣupte api anuvṛttim āmananti 'yadvai tanna paśyati paśyanvai tanna paśyati'
tathā ca śrutiḥ - 'kiṃ prajayā kariṣyāmo yeṣāṃ no 'yamātmāyaṃ lokaḥ'
smṛtiḥ api - 'yastvātmaratireva syādātmatṛptaśca mānavaḥ / ātmanyeva ca saṃtuṣṭasya kāryaṃ na vidyate'
grāhayanti ca ātmatvena eva īśvaraṃ vedāntavākyāni 'eṣa ta ātmā sarvāntaraḥ'
yatra hi pratīkadṛṣṭiḥ abhipreyate sakṛdeva tatra vacanaṃ bhavati yathā - 'mano brahma'
tathā hi - 'atha yo 'nyāṃ devatāmupāste 'nyo 'sāvanyo 'hamīti na sa veda'
'mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyumāpnoti ya iha nāneva paśyati'
vākyaśeṣaḥ api ca dvitīyānirdeśena ādityādīneva upāstikriyayā vyāpyamānān darśayati - 'sa ya etamevaṃ vidvānādityaṃ brahmetyupāste'
prathamanirdiṣṭeṣu ca ādityādiṣu caramanirdiṣṭaṃ brahma adhyastam 'ādityo brahmetyādeśaḥ'
prathamanirdiṣṭāḥ ca pṛthivyādayaḥ caramanardiṣṭā hiṅkārādayaḥ 'pṛthivī hiṅkāraḥ'
'yadeva vidyayā karoti śraddhayopaniṣadā tadeva vīryavattaraṃ bhavati'
bhavatu karmasamṛddhiphaleṣu evaṃ, svatantraphaleṣu tu katham 'ya etadevaṃ vidvāṃllokeṣu pañcavidhaṃ sāmopāste'
yatra api tulyo dvitīyanirdeśaḥ - 'atha khalvamumādityaṃ saptavidhaṃ sāmopāsīta'
iti, tatra api 'samastasya khalu sāmna upāsanaṃ sādhu'
etasmāt eva ca sāmna upāsyatva avagamāt 'pṛthivī hiṅkāraḥ'
smaranti api ca śiṣṭā upāsana aṅgatvena āsanam - 'śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ'
nanu viśeṣam api kecit āmananti - 'same śucau kharkarāvahnivālukāvivarjite śabdajalāśrayādibhiḥ / manonukūle natu cakṣupīḍane guhānivātāśrayaṇe prayojayet'
smṛtiḥ api - 'yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram / taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ'
tathā hi brahmavidyā prakriyāyāṃ saṃbhāvyamānasaṃbandhasya āgāmino duritasya anabhisaṃbandhaṃ viduṣo vyapadiśati - 'yathā puṣkarapalāśa āpo na śliṣyanta evamevaṃvidi pāpaṃ karma na śliṣyate'
tathā vināśam api pūrva ucitasya duritasya vyapadiśati - 'tadyatheṣīkātūlamagnau protaṃ pradūyetaivaṃ hāsya sarve pāpmānaḥ pradūyante'
asti ca śrutau puṇye api pāpmaśabdaḥ 'nainaṃ setumahorātre tarataḥ'
kuta etat - 'tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye 'tha saṃpatsye'
kutaḥ - 'tametaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena'
'ya evaṃ vidvānayajati' 'ya evaṃ vidvāñjuhoti' 'ya evaṃ vidvāñchaṃsati' 'ya evaṃ vidvāngāyati' 'tasmādevaṃvidameva brahmāṇaṃ kurviti nānevaṃ vidaṃ'
'tenobhau kuruto yaścaitadevaṃ veda yaśca na veda'
tathā hi śrutiḥ - 'yadeva vidyayā karoti śraddhayopaniṣadā tadeva vīryavattaraṃ bhavati'
anārabdhakāryayoḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ vidyāsāmarthyāt kṣaya uktaḥ itare tu ārabdhakārye puṇyapāpe upabhogena kṣapayitvā brahma saṃpadyate 'tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye 'tha saṃpatsye'
asti prāyaṇaviṣayā śrutiḥ 'asya somya puruṣasya prayato vāk manasi saṃpadyate manaḥ prāṇe prāṇa- tejasi tejaḥ parasyāṃ devatāyām'
tathā hi - 'annamayaṃ hi somya mana āpomayaḥprāṇaḥ'
darśayataḥ ca etam arthaṃ praśnaprativacane 'āpaḥ puruṣavacasaḥ'
nanu ca upasaṃhṛteṣu vāk ādiṣu karaṇeṣu śarīrāntaraprepsāvelāyāṃ 'kvāyaṃ tadā puruṣo bhavati'
iti upakramya śrutyantaraṃ karmāśrayatāṃ nirūpayati - 'tau ha yadūcatuḥ karma haiva tadūcaturatha ha yatpraśaśaṃsatuḥ karma haiva tatpraśaśaṃsatuḥ'
tathā hi 'yatraitatpuruṣaḥ svapiti nāma' 'aśiśiṣati nāma' 'pipāsati nāma'
pratiṣiddhā ca eṣā viduṣaḥ 'na tasya prāṇā utkrāmanti'
tatra api kenacit kāraṇena utkrāntim āśaṅkya pratiṣedhati - 'athākāmayamāno yo 'kāmo niṣkāma āptakāma ātmakāmo bhavati na tasya prāṇā utkrāmanti brahmaiva sanbrahmāpyeti'
tathā hi - ārtabhāgapraśne 'yatrāyaṃ puruṣo mriyata udasmātprāṇāḥ krāmantyāho neti'

iti anutkrāntipakṣaṃ parigṛhya na tarhi ayam anutkrānteṣu prāṇeṣu mriyata iti asyām āśaṅkāyām 'atraiva samavanīyanta' iti pravilayaṃ prāṇānāṃ pratijñāya tat siddhaye 'sa ucchvayatyādhyātmāyatyādhmāto mṛtaḥ śete'
api ca 'cakṣuṣo vā mūrdhno vānyebhyo vā śarīradeśebhyastamutkrāmantaṃ prāṇo 'nūtkrāmati prāṇo 'nūtkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anūtkrāmanti'
iti evam avidvat viṣayaṃ saprapañcam utkramaṇaṃ saṃsāragamanaṃ ca darśayitvā 'iti nu kāmayamānaḥ'
tathā hi āha śrutiḥ - 'evamevāsya paridraṣṭurimāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ puruṣāyaṇāḥ puruṣaṃ prāpyāstaṃ gacchanti
tathā hi kalāpralayam uktvā vakti - 'bhidyate tāsāṃ nāmarūpe puruṣa ityevaṃ procyate sa eṣo 'kalo 'mṛto bhavati'
tat agraprajvalanapūrvikā cakṣurādisthāna apādānā ca utkrāntiḥ śrūyate - 'tasya haitasya hṛdayasyāgraṃ pradyotate tena pradyotenaiṣa ātmā niṣkrāmati cakṣuṣo vā mūrdhno vānyebhyo vā śarīradeśebhyaḥ'
tathā hi hārdavidyāṃ prakṛtya samāmananti - 'śataṃ caikā ca hṛdayasya nāḍyastāsāṃ mūrdhānamabhiniḥsṛtaikā / tayordhvamāyannamṛtatvameti viṣvaṅṅnyā utkrameṇa bhavanti'
asti hārdavidyā - 'atha yadidamasminbrahmapure daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ veśma'
tat prakriyāyām 'atha yā etā hṛdayasya nāḍyaḥ'
iti upakramya saprapañcaṃ nāḍīraśmisaṃbandham uktvā uktam 'atha yatraitadasmāccharīrādutkrāmatyathaitaireva raśmibhirūrdhvamākramate'
darśayati ca etamarthaṃ śrutiḥ - 'amuṣmādādityātpratāyante tā āsu nāḍīṣu sṛptā ābhyo nāḍībhyaḥ pratāyante te 'muṣminnāditye sṛptāḥ'
uttarāyaṇa maraṇa prāśasti aprasiddherbhīṣmasya ca pratīkṣādarśanāt 'āpūryamāṇapakṣādyānṣaḍudaṅṅeti māsāṃstān'
nanu ca - 'yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ / prayātā yānti taṃ phalaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha'
tathā hi pañcāgnividyāprakaraṇe 'ye 'cāmī araṇye śraddhāṃ satyamupāsate'
tathā hi 'te teṣu brahmalokeṣu parāḥ parāvato vasanti'
lokaśabdaḥ ca prāṇināṃ bhogāyataneṣu bhāṣyate - 'manuṣyalokaḥ pitṛloko devalokaḥ'
tathā hi 'candramaso vidyutaṃ tatpuruṣo 'mānavaḥ sa etānbrahma gamayati'
arcirādi śabdatā ca eṣām arcirādi abhimānāt upapadyate 'arciṣo 'haḥ'
brahmalokāngamayati te teṣu brahmalokeṣu parāḥ parāvato vasanti'
iti teṣām iha na punarāvṛttiḥ asti 'tayordhvamāyannamṛtatvameti'
na hi tatra vidyāntaraprakramaḥ asti 'anyatra dharmādanyatrādharmāt'
iti na ayaṃ kāryaviṣayaḥ pratipatti abhisaṃdhiḥ 'nāmarūpayornirvahitā te yadantarā tadbrahma'
'sā ceyaṃ veśmapratipattirgatipūrvikā hārdavidyāyāmuditā tadaparājitā pūrbrahmaṇaḥ prabhuvimitaṃ hiraṇmayam'
paravidyāprakaraṇe api ca tat stutyarthaṃ vidyāntara āśrayagati anukīrtanam upapadyate 'viṣvaṅṅanyā utkramaṇe bhavanti'
yat sarvagataṃ sarvāntaraṃ sarvātmakaṃ ca paraṃ brahma 'ākāśavatsarvagataśca nityaḥ' 'yatsākṣādaparokṣādbrahma'
tathā hi 'tatraitacchruṅgamutpatitaṃ somya vijānīhi nedamamūlaṃ bhaviṣyati'
śāstraṃ ca 'yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati taditara itaraṃ paśyati
ityādinā aprabuddhaviṣaye pratyakṣādi vyavahāram uktvā punaḥ prabuddhaviṣaye 'yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūttatkena kaṃ paśyet'
tathā hi kvacit pañcāgnividyāṃ prakṛtya gatiḥ ucyate yathā 'prāṇo brahma kaṃ brahma khaṃ brahma'
na kvacit parabrahmaviṣayā gatiḥ śrāvyate yathā gatipratiṣedhaḥ śrāvitaḥ 'na tasya prāṇā utkrāmanti'

ityādiṣu tu satyapi āpnoteḥ gatyarthatve varṇitena nyāyena deśāntaraprāpti asaṃbhavāt svarūpapratipattiḥ eva iyam avidyā adhyāropita nāma rūpa pravilaya apekṣayā abhidhīyate 'brahmaiva sanbrahmāpyeti'
bāḍhaṃ dve 'etadvai satyakāma paraṃ cāparaṃ brahmayadoṅkāraḥ'
tat eva yatra nāmarūpādiviśeṣeṇa kenacit viśiṣṭam upāsanāya upadiśyate 'manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīro bhārūpaḥ'
tasya ca aparabrahma upāsanasya tat saṃnidhau śrūyamāṇam 'sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati'
nanu abrahmakratuḥ api brahmagacchati iti śrūyate yathā pañcāgni vidyāyām 'sa enānbrahma gamayati'
nāmādiṣu pratīka upāsaneṣu pūrvasmāt pūrvasmāt phalaviśeṣam uttarasmin uttarasmin upāsane darśayati - 'yāvannāmno gataṃ tatrāsya yathākāmacāro bhavati'
iti avasthātraya doṣavihīnam ātmānaṃ vyākhyeyatvena pratijñāya 'aśarīraṃ vāva santaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ
iti ca upanyasya 'svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate sa uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ'
kathaṃ punaḥ mukta iti ucyate - yāvatā 'paraṃ jyotirupasaṃpadya'
yata jyotiḥ śabdena āvedyate prakaraṇāt 'ya ātmāpahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyuḥ'
jyotiḥśabdaḥ tu ātmani api dṛśyate 'taddevā jyotiṣaṃ jyotiḥ

paraṃ jyotiḥ upasaṃpadya svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate yaḥ sa kiṃ parasmāt ātmanaḥ pṛthageva bhavati uta avibhāgena eva avatiṣṭhata vīkṣāyām sa 'tatra paryeti' ( 8.12.3) iti adhikaraṇa adhikartavya nirdeśāt jyotiḥ upasaṃpadya
'yathodakaṃ śuddhe śuddhamāsiktaṃ tādṛgeva bhavati / evaṃ muneḥ vijānata ātmā bhavati gautama'
tathā ca śrutiḥ - 'evaṃ vā are 'yamātmānantaro 'bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñānaghana eva'
hārdavidyāyāṃ śrūyate - 'sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati saṃkalpādevāsya pitaraḥ samuttiṣṭhanti'
śrutiḥ ca etat darśayati - 'atha ya ihātmānamanuvidya vrajantyeśca satyānkāmāṃsteṣāṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu kāmacāro bhavati'
kutaḥ, tathā hi darśayati śāstram ekasya anekabhāvam - 'sa ekadhā bhavati tridhā bhavati pañcadhā saptadhā navadhā'
kathaṃ punaḥ muktasya anekaśarīra āveśādilakṣaṇam aiśvaryam abhyupagamyate yāvatā 'tatkena kaṃ vijānīyāt'
katham avagamyate yataḥ tatra eva etat adhikāravaśāt āviṣkṛtam 'etebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānu vinaśyati na pretya saṃjñāstīti'
'na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅ ko na pāvakaḥ'

itaḥ ca na niraṅ kuśaṃ vikāra ālambanānām aiśvaryaṃ yasmāt bhogamātram eva eṣām anādisiddhena īśvareṇa samānam iti śrūyate - 'tamāhāpo vai khalu mīyante loko 'sau' iti 'sa yathaitāṃ devatāṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyavantyevaṃ haivaṃvidaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyavanti teno etasyai devatāyai sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ jayati'
